Entries.Title: Along with the Gods: The Two Worlds
Entries.Description: Having died unexpectedly, firefighter Ja-hong is taken to the afterlife by 3 afterlife guardians. Only when he passes 7 trials over 49 days and proves he was innocent in human life, he’s able to reincarnate, and his 3 afterlife guardians are by his side to defend him in trial.

Entries.Title: Bad Genius
Entries.Description: Lynn, a brilliant student, after helping her friends to get the grades they need, develops the idea of starting a much bigger exam-cheating business.

Entries.Title: Terra Formars
Entries.Description: With the space program attempting to travel to Mars, 21st century scientists were tasked with warming up the planet so that humans could survive on its surface. They came up with an efficient and cost effective plan of sending cockroaches and mold to the surface so that the mold would absorb the sunlight and the insect corpses would serve as a food source for the mold.  It is now the year 2577 and the first manned ship to Mars has landed on the planet and the six crew members are ready for their mission. But what they find are giant mutated humanoid cockroaches with incredible physical strength. The crew members are easily wiped out, but not before sending a transmission back to Earth. Now, humanity will send elite warriors to exterminate the mutated bugs and claim back Mars.

Entries.Title: Allegiant
Entries.Description: Beatrice Prior and Tobias Eaton venture into the world outside of the fence and are taken into protective custody by a mysterious agency known as the Bureau of Genetic Welfare.

Entries.Title: 20th Century Girl
Entries.Description: In 1999, a teen girl keeps close tabs on a boy in school on behalf of her deeply smitten best friend – then she gets swept up in a love story of her own.

Entries.Title: The Executioner
Entries.Description: An executioner questions his profession in response to an absurd accusation against a suspect.

Entries.Title: War Machine
Entries.Description: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

Entries.Title: We Can Be Heroes
Entries.Description: Ben never knew his father; he was killed in 9/11 when Ben was just a baby. Eleven years later, Ben goes to spend the summer with his grandparents, hanging out with Priti, the girl next door, and his wayward cousin, Jed. Priti is a livewire and a Muslim who gradually begins to suspect her older brother is a terrorist. The trio set out to investigate and uncover more than they expected in this family film.

Entries.Title: Men in Black: International
Entries.Description: The Men in Black have always protected the Earth from the scum of the universe. In this new adventure, they tackle their biggest, most global threat to date: a mole in the Men in Black organization.

Entries.Title: #Alive
Entries.Description: As a grisly virus rampages a city, a lone man stays locked inside his apartment, digitally cut off from seeking help and desperate to find a way out.

Entries.Title: Deadpool
Entries.Description: The origin story of former Special Forces operative turned mercenary Wade Wilson, who, after being subjected to a rogue experiment that leaves him with accelerated healing powers, adopts the alter ego Deadpool. Armed with his new abilities and a dark, twisted sense of humor, Deadpool hunts down the man who nearly destroyed his life.

Entries.Title: Extraction
Entries.Description: A hardened gun-for-hire's latest mission becomes a soul-searching race to survive when he's sent into Bangladesh to rescue a drug lord's kidnapped son.

Entries.Title: Extraction 2
Entries.Description: Back from the brink of death, highly skilled commando Tyler Rake takes on another dangerous mission: saving the imprisoned family of a ruthless gangster.

Entries.Title: Extreme Job
Entries.Description: A drug squad attempts to take down a criminal organization and they must go undercover to do so, so they begin working at a chicken restaurant, that becomes famous for its delicious chicken. Due to the unexpected popularity, the detectives find themselves in a situation they never expected.

Entries.Title: John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
Entries.Description: Super-assassin John Wick returns with a $14 million price tag on his head and an army of bounty-hunting killers on his trail. After killing a member of the shadowy international assassin’s guild, the High Table, John Wick is excommunicado, but the world’s most ruthless hit men and women await his every turn.

Entries.Title: John Wick: Chapter 4
Entries.Description: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

Entries.Title: The Roundup: No Way Out
Entries.Description: Detective Ma Seok-do changes his affiliation from the Geumcheon Police Station to the Metropolitan Investigation Team, in order to eradicate Japanese gangsters who enter Korea to commit heinous crimes.

Entries.Title: Train to Busan
Entries.Description: When a zombie virus pushes Korea into a state of emergency, those trapped on an express train to Busan must fight for their own survival.

Entries.Title: Troll
Entries.Description: When an explosion in the Norwegian mountains awakens an ancient troll, officials appoint a fearless paleontologist to stop it from wreaking deadly havoc.

Entries.Title: Blade: Trinity
Entries.Description: For years, Blade has fought against the vampires in the cover of the night. But now, after falling into the crosshairs of the FBI, he is forced out into the daylight, where he is driven to join forces with a clan of human vampire hunters he never knew existed—The Nightstalkers. Together with Abigail and Hannibal, two deftly trained Nightstalkers, Blade follows a trail of blood to the ancient creature that is also hunting him—the original vampire, Dracula.

Entries.Title: Chocolate
Entries.Description: Zen, an autistic teenage girl with powerful martial arts skills, gets money to pay for her sick mother Zin's treatment by seeking out all the people who owe Zin money and making them pay.

Entries.Title: Pee Mak
Entries.Description: Mak's friends just want to protect him, but his wife Nak won't let a small thing like her own death get in the way of true love.

Entries.Title: The Intruder
Entries.Description: In an old house, a man is bitten to death by a snake. The special services and the media congregate but are only able to find a few snakes. Later, a group of cobras invade the building which threatens the lives of the habitants.

Entries.Title: Van Helsing
Entries.Description: Famed monster slayer Gabriel Van Helsing is dispatched to Transylvania to assist the last of the Valerious bloodline in defeating Count Dracula. Anna Valerious reveals that Dracula has formed an unholy alliance with Dr. Frankenstein's monster and is hell-bent on exacting a centuries-old curse on her family.

Entries.Title: Fullmetal Alchemist
Entries.Description: Two alchemist brothers go on a quest for the Philosopher's Stone after an attempt to revive their dead mother goes horribly wrong.

Entries.Title: Resident Evil: Retribution
Entries.Description: The Umbrella Corporation’s deadly T-virus continues to ravage the Earth, transforming the global population into legions of the flesh eating Undead. The human race’s last and only hope, Alice, awakens in the heart of Umbrella’s most clandestine operations facility and unveils more of her mysterious past as she delves further into the complex. Without a safe haven, Alice continues to hunt those responsible for the outbreak; a chase that takes her from Tokyo to New York, Washington, D.C. and Moscow, culminating in a mind-blowing revelation that will force her to rethink everything that she once thought to be true. Aided by new found allies and familiar friends, Alice must fight to survive long enough to escape a hostile world on the brink of oblivion. The countdown has begun.

Entries.Title: Resident Evil: The Final Chapter
Entries.Description: Picking up immediately after the events in Resident Evil: Retribution, Alice is the only survivor of what was meant to be humanity's final stand against the undead. Now, she must return to where the nightmare began - The Hive in Raccoon City, where the Umbrella Corporation is gathering its forces for a final strike against the only remaining survivors of the apocalypse.

Entries.Title: Along with the Gods: The Last 49 Days
Entries.Description: As the deceased soul Ja-hong and his three afterlife guardians prepare for their remaining trials for reincarnation, the guardians soon come face to face with the truth of their tragic time on Earth 1,000 years earlier.

Entries.Title: Wonder Woman
Entries.Description: On the mystical island of Themyscira, a proud and fierce warrior race of Amazons have raised a daughter of untold beauty, grace and strength: Princess Diana. When an Army fighter pilot, Steve Trevor, crash-lands on the island, the rebellious and headstrong Diana defies Amazonian law by accompanying Trevor back to civilization.

Entries.Title: Swapped
Entries.Description: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

Entries.Title: The K2
Entries.Description: A patriotic bodyguard who was abandoned by his country and colleagues, a hidden daughter of leading Presidential candidate who regards love as a tool for revenge, and the First Lady contender who hides her ambition and charisma behind a kind and friendly personality.

Entries.Title: Mercy for None
Entries.Description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After Nam Gi-seok's mysterious death, Nam Gi-jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After tracking down Gi-seok's hit, Gi-jun discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun-mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi-jun himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi-seok's hit. After Jun-mo attacks his friends, Gi-jun goes head-to-head with Jun-mo's army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeong-do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum-son seizes power, Gi-jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum-son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi-jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

Title: Catch The Ghost
Description: A romantic investigative drama about rookie detective Yoo-Ryung who solves cases with her overflowing sense of justice and exceptional spatial perception but always gets herself into trouble because of her rash actions. She meets the Wangsimni station constabulary chief, a man who avoids cases and seeks stability who always ends up cleaning up after the problems caused by Yoo Ryung and holds the key to solving the cases.

Episodes.Title: Job Interview & Audition
Episodes.Description: The Subway Police of Wangsoori Station is led by Chief Inspector Ko Ji Seok. He is the best of the best, although his only goal in life is to have a stable, uneventful career. However, a serial killer, nicknamed “the Subway Ghost”, strikes the Subway Police 30 Year Anniversary event. An applicant shows up for a job interview to join the team.

Episodes.Title: Going Home to Family
Episodes.Description: Ryung officially becomes a member of the Wangsoori Subway Police and Ji Seok’s partner. Ryung gets into trouble from the start, because she sneaks into the tunnels. Meanwhile, an elderly man who delivers packages via subway becomes the victim of an assault. Ji Seok realizes that the package is related to criminal activities. While Ji Seok wants to hand the case over, Ryung acts before she thinks, as always.

Episodes.Title: Disciplinary Hearing
Episodes.Description: Ryung and Ji Seok attend the disciplinary committee hearing and return to the station for night duty. Thanks to Ji Seok’s martial arts demonstration and a pot of noodles, Ryung gets her hands on the screen door keys once more. Meanwhile, an ordinary father, whose livelihood takes place on the subway, goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Tracking Down the Grasshoppers
Episodes.Description: Ryung and Ji Seok save Choi Do Chul just in time. Throughout their investigation, Ji Seok miraculously learns to appreciate Ryung’s over-the-top nature. Meanwhile, a star professional fighter becomes the PR Ambassador for the Subway Police. By chance, Ryung comes across his dirty secret and the Wangsoori Subway Police finally get a lead on the Grasshoppers.

Episodes.Title: Club Day
Episodes.Description: Ji Seok makes up his mind to kick Ryung out of the Subway Police for taking investigations into her own hands all the time. However, Ryung is attacked while out on an investigation by herself and there is something weird about the man who seems to be following her. Meanwhile, the Wangsoori Subway Police get dressed up to go out on Club Day, the best day to boost their arrest records.

Episodes.Title: A Petty Thief?
Episodes.Description: A rumor circulates about people disappearing after they party all night on Club Day, then taking the first train home. Ryung and Ji Seok get on the first train to find out whether the rumor is true. During their train ride, they run into a suspicious petty thief and the truth about the first train rumor comes to light. Meanwhile, Ryung finally meets the Subway Ghost a month after joining the Subway Police.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy & Confusion
Episodes.Description: Subway Police and the Metropolitan Detective Division come together for a joint investigation. Despite Ji Seok’s jealousy, the joint investigation team switch partners. Ji Seok and Ma Ri become one team, while Ryung and Woo Hyuk become another. Meanwhile, Ji Seok decides to let Ryung transfer to a different team. As Ma Ri approaches him again, Ji Seok feels confused.

Episodes.Title: Facing the Harsh Truth
Episodes.Description: Ma Ri leaves Ryung after saying harsh words that keep replaying in Ryung’s mind. Still, Ryung continues her search for the Subway Ghost. But this time, she comes across someone willing to help. Meanwhile, an autistic boy goes missing from the bakery in Wangsoori Station and the Grasshoppers are on a pickpocketing spree once again. Ji Seok and Ryung have different priorities in which case to pursue.

Episodes.Title: Getting Closer to the Subway Ghost
Episodes.Description: Ryung and Ji Seok work together to save Jung Hoon and catch the kidnapper. With their great partnership, they discover the identity of the person who helps the kidnapper hide from the police. Meanwhile, the Subway Ghost marks his next target and Ryung activates her subway search skills to track him down.

Episodes.Title: The Hideout
Episodes.Description: The Subway Ghost’s hideout is finally uncovered. Through the evidence found in the hideout, the police slowly start to piece together the Subway Ghost’s identity. Meanwhile, Ryung’s illegal investigations in the tunnels come to the attention of the commissioner and Ji Seok faces the biggest crisis in his career.

Episodes.Title: Going After the Grasshoppers
Episodes.Description: The police make headway on the Subway Serial Murders and narrow down the suspect list. After getting a tip about the identity of one of the Grasshoppers, Ryung and the Metropolitan Detective Division chase him down as he might be the Subway Ghost. Meanwhile, Ji Seok’s investigative instincts start acting up again, despite his suspension.

Episodes.Title: The One that Got Away
Episodes.Description: One of the Grasshoppers gets away from the police. The other two Grasshoppers confess that they only know him as Han Tae Woong, although that name turns out to be a fake identity. The investigation reaches a dead end and Ji Seok is about to be reassigned to a remote island. Ryung comes up with a plan to save Ji Seok and to catch the Subway Ghost.

Episodes.Title: The Grasshoppers Are Behind Bars
Episodes.Description: Ji Seok and Ryung catch the remaining Grasshopper who everyone believes is the Subway Ghost. However, while being interrogated, the Captain of the Grasshoppers makes a shocking statement. The truth about the Subway Serial Murder Case finally begins to reveal itself and Ryung is hopeful that she may find out what happened to her sister.

Episodes.Title: The Subway Ghost Reveals Himself
Episodes.Description: The police believe the Subway Ghost is in a mental hospital and that he plans to commit another murder. They chase him down and search the entire hospital building. Amid the chaos, Ji Seok’s mom and her caretaker are nowhere to be found. The Subway Ghost leaves behind a video clip, revealing himself and the shocking truth.

Episodes.Title: The Subway Ghost’s Method
Episodes.Description: Ryung and Ji Seok make their way into Kyung Hee’s house and find a room that looks like a young girl’s. After sharing the new evidence with Ma Ri and her team, they split up into two groups to chase both Kyung Hee and Yi Joon. Meanwhile, Ryung’s hopes of finding Jin alive begin to grow and Ji Seok gets a call from the hospital about his mom.

Episodes.Title: Finally Catching the Subway Ghost
Episodes.Description: Finally, Ryung and the Subway Ghost come face to face. As his rage explodes, the Subway Ghost attacks Ryung, but another tragedy puts a stop to his actions in the end. Meanwhile, Jin appears at the scene, only to run away amidst the chaos. Ryung, the Subway Police, and Ma Ri’s team put in all their efforts into reuniting the twin sisters.

Title: Genie, Make a Wish
Description: After a thousand years, a quirky genie returns to grant wishes to a woman born without feelings. Can his magic bring love and wonder to her world?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a lifetime of abandonment, Ki Ka-young confronts her mother in Dubai. During her trip, she releases Iblis, indifferent to any wish he might grant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Back at Ka-young's home, Iblis learns about her past from the locals — and navigates modern Korean society while trying to threaten a wish from her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Iblis agrees to grant Ka-young's first wish — to corrupt others — although she remains an enigma. Meanwhile, Ejllael plots his revenge against Iblis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After sharing her first kiss with Iblis, Ka-young searches for any excuse to kiss him again. Ejllael struggles to sway Ka-young to his long-held plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ka-young makes her second wish — this time for her grandmother. Meanwhile, Iblis continues corrupting others in a bid to win his bet with Ka-young.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Iblis seeks Ejllael to probe his missing years with Ka-young. Meanwhile, Ka-young faces memories of her past life — and a fateful wish.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Despite learning of her past, Ka-young suspects there's more to her story with Iblis. Ejllael and Iblis discover a secret force lurking in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Iblis and Ka-young travel to Dubai for answers about their unaccounted past. Soon, Ka-young begins to feel an unexpected bond with him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Ejllael uses Oh Pan-geum as bait to bring down Iblis. As Khalid's threat grows, Iblis and Ka-young uncover a major clue about their past connection.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: With Khalid's next move imminent, Iblis and Ka-young dig into their blurry past. Meanwhile, Pan-geum prepares for her fate, stoking suspicion around her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: A millennia ago, Ka-young's past self survives certain death — reconnecting with Iblis and falling in love, until greed tragically tears them apart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: As Khalid's endgame nears, Ka-young, Iblis and their loved ones face grave danger — but their hidden plan can seal a destiny forged over a thousand years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: With her life turned upside down, Ka-young searches for Iblis to make her final wish. Will they find eternal happiness, or be bound by cruel fate?

Title: Sweet Home
Description: As humans turn into savage monsters and the world plunges into terror, a handful of survivors fight for their lives — and to hold on to their humanity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Cha Hyun-su moves into the run-down Green Home by himself. Not long after, he witnesses a disturbing sight in his neighbor's apartment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As a state of emergency is declared, the residents tie up Pyeon Sang-wook for being bitten. Hyun-su is unable to ignore a family in distress.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: An unexpected savior protects the children from harm as Hyun-su, together with Yoon Ji-su and Jung Jae-heon, tries to bring them to safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Critical information about the monsters is made public. When residents are split on what to do with Hyun-su, Lee Eun-hyeok suggests they hold a vote.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Tasked to carry out dangerous missions, Hyun-su heads back to retrieve Han Du-sik. Sang-wook stops at nothing to finish what he started.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: An Seon-yeong confronts the greatest monster in her life. Leaving the building, Seo Yi-kyung heads to her fiancé's office in search of answers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hyun-su saves the others from a deadly attack. Running out of necessities, Eun-hyeok announces a plan to venture outside for resources.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Having little options in her state of being, Ji-su agrees to take a big risk. Yi-kyung returns to Green Home just in time.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: When a team of outlaws take over the building, the residents are shown how humans can be even more barbaric than the monsters.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: A military leaflet promises a route to safety, but the group is reluctant to trust it. Hyun-su is exposed to a new perspective on his condition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Hyun-su wakes up to find Sang-wook, who has a new goal for them. Lee Eun-yu and Ji-su escape a violent evacuation and commandeer their next destination.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Eun-yu finds a hint of Eun-hyeok’s fate at a stop in her journey. During an experiment, Hyun-su finds that he has a special effect on another monster.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: On a mission to find her husband, Yi-kyung makes a shocking discovery. The battered Ji-su and Eun-yu arrive at a new shelter, but catastrophe awaits them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The survivors take shelter underground, where supplies run low. In her continued search for Eun-hyeok, Eun-yu encounters a young girl.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sergeant Kim and Master Sergeant Tak clash on how to protect their men. The mysterious girl approaches Eun-yu with an enticing offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Eun-yu chases Yi-kyung and the girl, with Park Chan-yeong right behind her. The death of survivors and a missing soldier throws the stadium into unrest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Eun-yu shares a terse reunion with Hyun-su. While the platoon embarks on their search for a missing soldier, the stadium experiences a monster threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Yi-kyung faces death, the young girl tries to save her. In the ruins of the lab, the soldiers discover other survivors who aren't what they seem.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Hyun-su gives it his all to bring Yi-kyung’s humanity back. Sergeant Kim faces countless monsters in an effort to make it out alive with his men.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Resolved to find his child, Jung Ui-myeong heads to the stadium. Despite Hyun-su's unpredictability, Eun-yu tries to wake him up during a sudden crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yi-kyung discovers Ui-myeong's true motive for him and their daughter. Eun-yu accepts a challenge from Hyun-su's alter ego and heads to the stadium.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The girl contemplates her future with Yi-kyung — and a life away from Ui-myeong. Sergeant Kim encounters Eun-hyeok, who reveals a new kind of being.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Eun-hyeok's reunion with Hyun-su and Eun-yu turns into chaos. Ui-myeong prepares for his body transfer, while Sergeant Tak carries out his own plan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In her trek to the stadium, Eun-yu begins to feel a personal worry. While Ui-myeong searches for the girl, she plans a counterattack in the background.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok arrive at the stadium, splitting up to find Ui-myeong. During the great escape, Sergeant Tak commits the ultimate sacrifice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: In the final battle, Hyun-su and Eun-hyeok confront the girl head-on — getting an assist from an old friend. Will they finally succeed?

Title: Mercy for None
Description: After severing ties with his gang, a former gangster returns to uncover the truth behind his brother's death — embarking on a relentless path of revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After Nam Gi-seok's mysterious death, Nam Gi-jun emerges from seclusion on a mission to find the perpetrator — no matter the cost.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After tracking down Gi-seok's hit, Gi-jun discovers the scheme's origin — forcing him to enforce a rule he established more than a decade ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's precautions, Gu Jun-mo underestimates the threat he faces. Frustrated and desperate, he decides to handle Gi-jun himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Desperate to save his son, Chairman Gu digs deeper into Gi-seok's hit. After Jun-mo attacks his friends, Gi-jun goes head-to-head with Jun-mo's army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gi-jun quickly learns that his problems don't end with Jun-mo. A gang war breaks out after Chairman Lee suspects the real architect behind recent events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Cha Yeong-do sets his plan in motion. As Lee Geum-son seizes power, Gi-jun faces betrayal, danger, and a race to uncover the truth behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: With all his obstacles cleared, Geum-son puts his endgame into play. Will Gi-jun succeed in stopping him, or go down trying?

Title: Strong Woman Do Bong-Soon
Description: Born with supernatural strength, Bong-soon fights evil and procures justice while getting tangled in a love triangle with her CEO boss and cop crush.

Episodes.Title: Ridiculous Punks
Episodes.Description: For generations, a superpower has been passed down the maternal line in Bong-soon's family. But for 27 years, she has always tried to keep it hidden.

Episodes.Title: A Criminal's Heart
Episodes.Description: As Min-hyuk spends the day shopping and playing, Bong-soon is forced to follow him around. While at a park, they spot a suspicious man spying on them.

Episodes.Title: That Jerk's Secret
Episodes.Description: Bong-soon finds a painting in Min-hyuk's closet that seems out of place. The next day, the two visit the owner of the motorcycle they saw at the park.

Episodes.Title: Her True Identity
Episodes.Description: Bong-soon struggles to control not just her power, but also her emotions. To make matters worse, Min-hyuk keeps giving her a hard time.

Episodes.Title: Seems As If They're a Friend, and Yet Not
Episodes.Description: The criminal at large seems to be attacking only certain people. Concerned for Bong-soon's safety, Min-hyuk and Guk-doo clash over how to protect her.

Episodes.Title: Happy Together
Episodes.Description: Not able to trust one another overnight, Bong-soon, Min-hyuk and Guk-doo decide to play games instead, evoking the two men's competitive spirits.

Episodes.Title: Changes
Episodes.Description: Osung Group's shareholders get angry when Min-hyuk fails to show up on time to the meeting to discuss his qualifications as the next company leader.

Episodes.Title: One Step Closer
Episodes.Description: Profilers suggest misogyny motivated the recent crimes. Bong-soon decides to put her dream of developing games second to catching the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Love Risking One's Life
Episodes.Description: Both Min-hyuk and Guk-doo arrive at the fight scene just before one of Baek Tak's men starts running toward Bong-soon with a dagger in hand.

Episodes.Title: Find A Hidden Heart
Episodes.Description: Frustrated with police legalism, Guk-doo takes drastic measures. Bong-soon is preoccupied with catching the culprit herself, which worries Min-hyuk.

Episodes.Title: Timing
Episodes.Description: With the kidnapping case still unsolved and both Min-hyuk and Guk-doo asking to see her that night, Bong-soon finds her life is full of dilemmas.

Episodes.Title: Help Me
Episodes.Description: Guk-doo's police team keeps hitting roadblocks while chasing down their suspect. Bong-soon senses something is off from Kyung-shim's text messages.

Episodes.Title: Nevertheless
Episodes.Description: Replaying the video of Kyung-shim, Bong-soon hears a strange background noise. Following his hunch, Guk-doo decides to check out the junkyard again.

Episodes.Title: A Prelude to the Battle
Episodes.Description: When Bong-soon doesn't come home late into the night, her dad gets worried. Guk-doo is conflicted over what to include on Kyung-shim's case report.

Episodes.Title: Level Up
Episodes.Description: With the case unresolved, Guk-doo's team visits Min-hyuk's company to gather clues. Guk-doo hears from Bong-soon the details of last night's events.

Title: You Are My Hero
Description: A story that follows Mi Ka, a new resident at the hospital who meets special ops agent Xing Kelei during an emergency rescue training organized by the SWAT team.

Episodes.Title: Lifesaver
Episodes.Description: Two years ago, a medical student, Mi Ka, got caught up in a jewelry heist and was abducted by criminals. A SWAT member, Xing Kelei, risked his life to rescue her. After Mi Ka's escape, she never crossed paths with her rescuer again, but she vividly remembered his deep eyes beneath the protective gear. Two years later, she encountered the Chief Instructor, Xing Kelei at, an emergency rescue training camp.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei informed the group of trainees that someone had sneaked out of the base. He made it clear that one person's mistake would result in punishment for the entire group. Mi Ka felt that Xing Kelei was cunning, but to obtain her certificate of completion, she had to swallow her pride and admit her fault. As the training continued, tension rose between them as they clashed, each unwilling to yield.

Episodes.Title: Saved Her for the Second Time
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka got lost in the mountains and injured her foot. Hearing that Mi Ka hadn't returned, Xing Kelei became anxious and went to look for her. Eventually, he discovered her trail at the foot of the mountain. Xing Kelei finally understood Mi Ka's reasons for leaving the base without permission. Seeing Mi Ka's warmth and enthusiasm, he finally understood her.

Episodes.Title: Fearlessly
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka suddenly received an urgent signal on the rescue app. There was an accident nearby in urgent need of rescue, but the surroundings were perilous. Mi Ka insisted on going to help, so Xing Kelei had no choice but to tie her with a rope and guide her safely to the accident scene.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: Under the guidance of Shao Yuhan and with the help of Xu Yanshan, MiKa successfully performed a thoracentesis and saved the patient's life. Shao Yuhan decided to have Mi Ka and Xu Yanshan join the Neurosurgery Department for rotation. Meanwhile, Xing Kelei's Tiger Commando Team was in pursuit of a group of drug traffickers.

Episodes.Title: Blaming Oneself
Episodes.Description: Xiao Chao's injury left Xing Kelei overwhelmed with guilt. Consequently, he poured out his heart to Mi Ka, who shared her journey as a doctor to comfort him. Later, Mi Ka found a certificate of completion tucked inside the undershirt that Xing Kelei had returned to her. This made her believe even more that Xing Kelei was a warm hearted person.

Episodes.Title: Reconciliation
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka was working hard to adapt to the busy and unpredictable situations in the Emergency Department, and she gained a deeper understanding of the importance of emergency work. Her efforts had finally earned recognition from Wei Lan. Xing Kelei waited for Mi Ka at the hospital entrance, wanting to apologize to her. They ended up arguing, but eventually reconciled.

Episodes.Title: Teamwork
Episodes.Description: A girl named Mumu drank insecticide and was rushed to the emergency room. Mi Ka, along with all available medical staff in the hospital, assisted in preparing the atropine. Meanwhile, Xing Kelei contacted Li Nian and others on duty, personally leading the team to deliver the medication.

Episodes.Title: The Weird Landlord
Episodes.Description: Upon hearing from Qing Xia that Mi Ka was homeless, Xing Kelei rented his house cheaply to Mi Ka and moved to Xing Keyao's house across the street. After moving in, Mi Ka noticed something was off. Every daily necessity she mentioned would mysteriously appear in the house the next day. Qing Xia even suspected that the landlord was a weirdo.

Episodes.Title: The One She Idolized
Episodes.Description: A crazed fan had kidnapped an idol in the city, prompting Xing Kelei to lead the team in tracking and rescuing work. Mi Ka went to the scene to provide support as a paramedic. Seeing Xing Kelei wearing protective gear, she was reminded of the SWAT officer who saved her two years ago.

Episodes.Title: Weekend Outing
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei made plans to go out with Mi Ka over the weekend, but little did he know that on the day of their outing, he received an urgent mission and had to leave abruptly. He asked Lu Feng to help take care of Mi Ka. Coincidentally, Mi Ka asked Qingxia to accompany her. Lu Feng was drawn to Qingxia's straightforward and capable demeanor.

Episodes.Title: New Recruits
Episodes.Description: There were new recruits to fill Xiao Chao's position. One of them turned out to be the lady Xing Kelei met at the supermarket the other day, Zhuo Wenjing. Zhuo Wenjing performed exceptionally well in the shooting competition, causing everyone to take notice of her.

Episodes.Title: Earthquake
Episodes.Description: A sudden earthquake struck Linan County. Xing Kelei led the Tiger Commando Team into Linan for rescue efforts. Meanwhile, at Renxin Hospital, Shao Yuhan also led Mi Ka, Xu Yanshan, Chen Tao, and others to the disaster area to join in the rescue work.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue Work
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka, Shao Yuhan, and the others arrived at the rescue headquarters in the earthquake zone. However, the number of casualties was overwhelming, and they couldn't cope. Meanwhile, Xing Kelei led the team into Mao Village. Zhuo Wenjing fell from a cliff and was injured, so Xing Kelei descended to the bottom of the cliff to stay with her and await help.

Episodes.Title: Opposing Stances
Episodes.Description: Due to heavy rain, the water level of the upstream reservoir in Xinguan Village surged rapidly. Xing Kelei received orders to evacuate all residents of Xinguan Village immediately. However, Shao Yuhan insisted on completing the surgery for a patient before leaving. Their opposing stances led to an argument.

Episodes.Title: Trapped
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei and Mi Ka ventured into the mine for a rescue mission. Just as they were about to exit the mine, a sudden aftershock damaged the elevator. With the auxiliary shaft blocked off, both of them were trapped inside the mine.

Episodes.Title: Life-And-Death Situation
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei and Mi Ka exhausted their strength but couldn't get out of the mine. As the oxygen in the mine gradually depleted, they felt their lives were nearing an end. It was then that Xing Kelei confessed his feelings to Mi Ka.

Episodes.Title: Sweet Moments After the Disaster
Episodes.Description: After safely leaving the mine, Xing Kelei and Mi Ka had their first date. They then resumed their duties at work. Mi Ka embraced her remaining time in the Emergency Department.

Episodes.Title: Professional Attitude
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka had been performing well in Neurosurgery, so Shao Yuhan asked Xu Yanshan to delegate some patients to Mi Ka to handle. However, Xu Yanshan had assigned Mi Ka only basic tasks. Nonetheless, MiKa still took them seriously.

Episodes.Title: Impartiality
Episodes.Description: Actress Chen Feifei was admitted to the hospital due to lower back pain, and tests revealed a possible diagnosis of astrocytoma. Undaunted by the trouble, Mi Ka made great efforts to persuade Chen Feifei to undergo surgery. Meanwhile, Xing Kelei showcased exceptional response during the simulated hostage rescue training.

Episodes.Title: Getaway
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei invited Mi Ka to go to the resort for a getaway. Mi Ka was surprised to find out about the past romantic relationship between Shao Yuhan and Xing Keyao. The couple plotted to bring Xing Keyao and Shao Yuhan together by arranging for them to go to the resort at the same time.

Episodes.Title: True Feelings
Episodes.Description: The group had a barbecue at the resort. Mi Ka and Xing Kelei made every effort to matchmake Shao Yuhan and Xing Keyao. Qingxia and Shu Wenbo felt a bit awkward watching. After the barbecue, Mi Ka suggested playing Truth or Dare to help Shao Yuhan and Xing Keyao confront their true feelings.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Upon hearing others talk about Shao Yuhan admiring Mi Ka, Xu Yanshan felt disheartened. Xing Kelei had blurred vision very frequently. He went for an examination and discovered a pituitary adenoma.

Episodes.Title: Emotional Distress
Episodes.Description: The doctor suggested that Xing Kelei undergo a craniotomy to remove the tumor. However, there might be complications afterward, and Xing Kelei may no longer be fit for frontline work. Xing Kelei felt extremely disheartened.

Episodes.Title: Inner Conflict
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei felt that his calling was to serve in the frontline of the SWAT Team, and if he were to give up that role, he truly didn't know what to do. On the other hand, Xu Yanshan's mom was admitted to the hospital. During her stay, she learned of Xu Yanshan's resignation and criticized the latter for being worthless. This led to an argument between the mother and daughter.

Episodes.Title: Initial Aspirations
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei confided his condition to Mi Ka. He thanked her for inadvertently saying things that lifted his spirits. Even if he couldn't continue frontline work in the future, his initial aspirations would remain unchanged.

Episodes.Title: Protecting His Dreams
Episodes.Description: Mi Ka actively sought better surgical options for Xing Kelei, and Shao Yuhan offered to perform minimally invasive surgery for him. Despite its difficulty, he was confident in his abilities. Xing Kelei thanked Mi Ka for protecting his dreams with her professionalism.

Episodes.Title: Strive to the Fullest
Episodes.Description: Under Mi Ka's care, Xing Kelei recovered rapidly. After working tirelessly for over 10 hours, Shao Yuhan faced a challenging surgery with a patient. Encouraged by Xing Keyao, both Shao Yuhan and Xing Keyao felt the care from each other.

Episodes.Title: Don't Give up on Your Dreams
Episodes.Description: Pianist Zhang Wei was hospitalized due to a car accident. She suffered functional damage to her right hand, which may hinder her ability to perform. Emotionally distressed, Zhang Wei attempted suicide, prompting Xing Kelei and Mi Ka to intervene.

Episodes.Title: Emotionally Attached
Episodes.Description: Under Mi Ka's guidance, Xing Kelei made great progress in training. Xing Keyao and Shao Yuhan met at a class reunion. As they reminisced about the past, they both realized they hadn't let go of each other.

Episodes.Title: Childhood Friend
Episodes.Description: Xing Kelei suggested moving in with Mi Ka, and she agreed. Xing Kelei's childhood friend, Shen Jianing, came to him seeking financial assistance. Unbeknownst to Xing Kelei, Shen Jianing had harbored feelings for him since they were young and hoped to take their relationship to the next level.

Episodes.Title: Gossip
Episodes.Description: Xing Ke Lei explained his relationship with the Shen sisters to Mi Ka. The latter reassured him that she never doubted him. Xing Kelei bore all of Shen Jianing's medical expenses, and she was successfully admitted to the hospital. However, her overreliance on Xing Kelei caused gossip to spread throughout the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Patience
Episodes.Description: With Shen Jianing's surgery approaching, Shen Jianan's sudden disappearance left Shen Jianing in a complete state of despair. Title: Bitch X Rich
Description: Kim Hye-in has to transfer to Cheongdam International High School after witnessing a murder. She crosses paths with Baek Je-na, a bully who happens to be connected to the case.

Episodes.Title: Dirt Poor
Episodes.Description: Hye-in, a student of Seonwoo Girls' High School, works as a part-timer to make ends meet. One day, she gets a tutoring job for a wealthy middle schooler who wants to go to Cheongdam International High School. While her student is away, Hye-in takes a photo with the student's designer bag, and the photo goes viral.

Episodes.Title: The Guilty One
Episodes.Description: Hye-in starts posting more pictures taken with Na-yeon's expensive stuff. She goes overboard and even tries on Cheongdam High's uniform. Na-yeon catches her in the uniform and finds the pictures Hye-in's been uploading. Hye-in begs Na-yeon not to tell her mom about it, and Na-yeon makes Hye-in run errands for her instead.

Episodes.Title: The Witness
Episodes.Description: Na-yeon's family makes complaints to Hye-in's school about her forgery and fraud. Hye-in is on the verge of getting expelled, so she meets the school director of Cheongdam High and begs for mercy. There, she witnesses something she shouldn't have.

Episodes.Title: Barking Up The Wrong Tree
Episodes.Description: Hye-in is offered a place in Cheongdam International High School in return for keeping silent about the incident she witnessed. She buys a new pair of shoes for her new school but accidentally loses them. She runs into Je-na, who happened to be wearing the same shoes and mistakes her for a thief.

Episodes.Title: The Fiery Pit
Episodes.Description: Hye-in forcefully takes the designer shoes off of Je-na and hurts her without knowing who she is. Je-na is determined to make Hye-in's life miserable at school. Do-eon sees Hye-in's application for enrolment in his father's study and decides to approach her.

Episodes.Title: The Sorority Party
Episodes.Description: Do-eon asks Hye-in to tell him what happened on the night Hae-in fell from the rooftop. But Hye-in sets a condition in exchange for telling the truth. Hye-in gets invited to the sorority party, an exclusive party for the rich. There, she runs into Je-na again.

Episodes.Title: The Deal
Episodes.Description: Je-na teaches Hye-in a lesson by ruining her dress and humiliating her at the party. After finding out what happened to Hye-in, Do-eon warns Je-na to stop bullying her. But Je-na pushes Hye-in further and tells her to drop out.

Episodes.Title: The Part-time Job
Episodes.Description: Si-eun tells Hye-in about Lee Duk-min who lends money to the kids in urgent need of money. Hye-in ends up borrowing money from Duk-min without knowing the consequences it could bring. Meanwhile, Do-eon asks Hye-in to help him one more time...

Episodes.Title: Oh Si-eun's True Colours
Episodes.Description: Je-na confronts Si-eun, telling her to leave Hye-in alone, but Si-eun backs her off with the story of her brother. Hye-in is shocked to find out what Si-eun wanted in the first place, but she doesn't back down and finds a way to make it through.

Episodes.Title: Déjà Vu
Episodes.Description: So-mang catches Si-eun and Hye-in in the secluded restroom. After hearing how Si-eun blackmailed Hye-in, he promises to help her. On the day of Yul-hee and Woo-jin's anniversary, the ugly truth gets revealed. Hye-in witnesses something she shouldn't have again.

Episodes.Title: Vengeance Ignited by the Privileged
Episodes.Description: After Oh Si Eun's death, Kim Hye In becomes the prime suspect in the murder investigation. At school, her classmates harass her with scorn, labeling her an 'Equal Opportunity loser.' Realizing that she may never be able to change the course of her life, Hye In resolves to fight back.

Episodes.Title: New Members of Diamond 6 Unveiled
Episodes.Description: Je Na goes through daily distress caused by her family. Her father is on the verge of divorce, and Cha Jin Uk, a suitor with a contract marriage in mind, suddenly enters the picture. Meanwhile, facing expulsion, Hye In proposes a deal to Je Na to include her as a member of Diamond 6. Would Je Na accept Hye In’s offer?

Episodes.Title: Secrets Unfold At Cheongdam High School
Episodes.Description: With Je Na’s help, Hye In makes it into Diamond 6 and decides to act accordingly. Meanwhile, Hae In regains consciousness in the hospital and returns to Cheongdam International High School, but she appears to have lost her memory. Another new student, Jin Uk becomes the subject of gossip. As the backstories of the main characters gradually come to light, will Hye In be able to make it through school life safely?

Episodes.Title: Secrets Unveiled, Bold Moves At The Party
Episodes.Description: Amidst being mistreated and looked down upon for her memory loss, Hae In seems to make up her mind and asks Do Eon to take her as his partner to the party. Meanwhile, Je Na joins the party and reveals her secret in front of everyone. As the main characters make bold moves, what is the secret that Hae In is hiding? And what kind of consequences will it bring?

Episodes.Title: Friend Or Foe, Who Can Be Trusted
Episodes.Description: As relationships twist and allegiances shift, Yul Hui begins reaching out to Je Na’s enemies, determined to bring her down. On Je Na’s side, her once dismissive attitude toward Jin Uk begins to soften and the two form a reluctant yet increasingly cooperative alliance. In a tangled web of betrayal, manipulation, and shifting loyalties, no one can tell who is truly a friend or an enemy.

Episodes.Title: Rumours Of Baek Je Na
Episodes.Description: Hye In interrogates Sa Rang about whether he is actually Black Dog. Ultimately, Sa Rang confesses the truth regarding Oh Si Eun’s cellphone. After hearing Sa Rang’s account, Hye In is convinced that the person who took Si Eun’s phone is the one who pushed Si Eun. Meanwhile, rumours begin to spread about Baek Je Na’s drug abuse.

Episodes.Title: Unravelling The Truth Behind A Murder
Episodes.Description: Framed in a drug scandal orchestrated by Yul Hui, Je Na’s downfall seems imminent, until her allies step in. Meanwhile, Hye In follows a clue tied to a wrist injury and begins to suspect who holds Si Eun’s phone. With everyone hiding their true loyalties and intentions, can Hye In uncover the truth and protect herself before it’s too late?

Episodes.Title: Ties That Strangle
Episodes.Description: Tensions escalate as Hye In is forced into submission, becoming Yul Hui's pawn. However, Yul Hui's schemes unravel when her role in a setup against Je Na is exposed, putting her in a desperate position. Meanwhile, a new strategy emerges to take down Diamond 6 members, with plans to leak the truth through Black Dog's channel.

Episodes.Title: Truth, Betrayal, And A Choice That Changes Everything
Episodes.Description: After Hae In's death, the fragile balance between the characters starts to collapse. Yul Hui pressures Hye In to expose Je Na with a lie during her engagement ceremony with Jin Uk, using a video as leverage. As the fateful day approaches, Hye In stands at a crossroads. With everyone watching, Hye In’s next move could change everything. Will she betray and bring Je Na down, or choose the truth?

Episodes.Title: The Reckoning
Episodes.Description: Despite the risk of revealing herself, Hye In bravely exposes Yul Hui and the web of corruption festering within the school during Je Na's wedding. As her meticulous plan sets off a chain reaction, buried truths begin to surface, drawing everyone deeper into chaos. Loyalties get tested, and tension simmers dangerously close to exploding. Meanwhile, Yul Hui seethes with rage as damning accusations come at her from all sides.

Title: Scarlet Heart: Ryeo
Description: A story of a 25-year-old Go Hajin who is transported back in time to the Goryeo Dynasty. She then wakes up in the body of Lady Hae Soo and finds herself amongst the ruling princes of the Wang Family.

Episodes.Title: Traveling Back to Goryeo
Episodes.Description: After seemingly drowning in the present day, Go Hajin wakes up in the Goryeo era, assuming the body of Lady Hae Soo. The princes of the palace nervously await the return of their brother, 4th Prince Wang So.

Episodes.Title: So's Real Face
Episodes.Description: Hajin's feisty behavior gets her into trouble with 10th Prince Wang Eun, as well as the mysterious and dangerous So. The spiritual ritual ceremony arrives.

Episodes.Title: The One Behind
Episodes.Description: So and 8th Prince Wang Wook realize something troubling in the forest. Hajin tries to more convincingly assume her new identity.

Episodes.Title: Staying in Songak
Episodes.Description: Lady Hae Myeong feels as though she has not fulfilled her duties as a wife to Wook. Hajin begins to better understand So.

Episodes.Title: The First Time I Met You
Episodes.Description: Hajin tries to push aside her feelings for Wook, while Lady Hae tries to push the two closer together. So adjusts to his new life in the palace, though not everyone is delighted by his presence.

Episodes.Title: Hae-soo Cut Her Wrist
Episodes.Description: Hajin is informed that she will be getting married. She is reluctant, but her betrothed is a man whose grasp is difficult to escape.

Episodes.Title: A Court Lady in Damiwon
Episodes.Description: Hajin's new life as a court lady presents more challenges than expected. The palace celebrates Eun's birthday.

Episodes.Title: The Ritual Ceremony
Episodes.Description: Hajin discovers the real reason Court Lady Oh Sooyeon is so strict with her. A rain ritual is planned to help end the drought.

Episodes.Title: He Is King Gwangjong
Episodes.Description: Hajin realizes which prince will become King Gwangjong and wonders if she can change the future. A royal marriage is determined.

Episodes.Title: The Proposal
Episodes.Description: Wook begins to feel threatened by So's relationship with "Soo". News of the Crown Prince's family causes trouble for him within the palace.

Episodes.Title: Begging for Forgiveness
Episodes.Description: Hajin is placed under arrest for poisoning So, and Wook must prove her innocence before it is too late.

Episodes.Title: Assassinate the King
Episodes.Description: Hajin is demoted to a water maid while So is sent away to Later Jin. One year later, the peace gathering approaches.

Episodes.Title: The Rebellion
Episodes.Description: The king sends Hajin on an imperative mission, but to succeed, she must learn who she can and cannot trust.

Episodes.Title: Opening Up
Episodes.Description: So must make a sacrifice for the sake of the king and his daughter. The princes are stunned to reunite with a familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Looking for Eun and His Wife
Episodes.Description: King Jeongjong sends So after Eun for "plotting treason," and Hajin is again unsure of who she can trust.

Episodes.Title: A Test
Episodes.Description: Eun and Park Soondeok try to escape the Damiwon. So decides that he must become King of Goryeo, which means he must make sacrifices.

Episodes.Title: Goryeo's 3rd King
Episodes.Description: 3rd Prince Wang Yo's mental and physical health continue to dwindle, and So takes advantage. Princess Hwangbo Yeonhwa and Queen Hwangbo come up with a new plan for the future of their family.

Episodes.Title: The Empress
Episodes.Description: So is pressured to marry Yeonhwa. Queen Yoo falls ill upon hearing that 14th Prince Wang Jeong is being punished.

Episodes.Title: Leaving the Palace
Episodes.Description: 13th Prince Wang Baeka is chosen to lead soldiers in pacifying the slaves of Hubaekje. Jeong reveals to So his plan to marry Hajin and take her away from the palace.

Episodes.Title: The Letters
Episodes.Description: Hajin leaves the palace to live with Jeong, but her condition worsens. Will she and So reunite before it's too late?

Title: Study Group
Description: A struggling student at Korea's worst high school forms a study group while protecting his classmates with his fighting skills, hoping to overcome academic challenges and secure a spot in college.

Episodes.Title: Study Group
Episodes.Description: Ga-min is passionate about studying and puts all his efforts into it. However, he never received a good grade, which made him go to Yusung Technical High School. The school is known as a gangster training school, and unlike Ga-min, not many students are into studying. However, Ga-min wants to try a new method of studying, which is forming a study group. He asks his classmate Se-hyun to join him, but he tells Ga-min about a problem he has.

Episodes.Title: The School Inspector
Episodes.Description: Ga-min gets into an unexpected fight against Hyeon U, a school bully. As the fight goes on, the two become the center of attention of everyone in school. At that moment, a man enters the classroom that has become a mess because of the two, and it turns out that he is a school inspector. The vice-principal who got furious about the incident decides to expel Ga-min from school.

Episodes.Title: A New Member
Episodes.Description: Someone applied to the study group. Ga Min is excited to meet the applicant, but it turns out that it is Ji U, Hyeon U’s twin sister. Kyu Jin, a member of the student council, picks on Ji U, and Ga Min confronts him. Han Wul tells Hyeon U about Kyu Jin who was blackmailing Ji U. Meanwhile, Ranked 1 among the 1st years comes to see Ga Min.

Episodes.Title: Teach Me How to Fight
Episodes.Description: Jun is impressed by Ga Min who defeated the rankers. He applies to join the study group and asks Ga Min to teach him how to fight. However, Ga Min rejects him because he only wants students who actually want to study in the study group. Jun decides to join the gang to become stronger, but it only gets him in trouble. Ga Min and his friends go to rescue him.

Episodes.Title: A Real Loser
Episodes.Description: The study group is finally complete. But the school’s top student, Kim Ho Min bullies Se Hyun, who grew up in the same neighbourhood. He tramples on Se Hyun’s pride and beats him up, calling him a poor loser. Ga Min steps up to help him, but it only makes Se Hyun feel like a real loser. After refusing to go to Ga Min’s house, Se Hyun wanders around and ends up running into Ho Min.

Episodes.Title: Ga Min’s Transfer
Episodes.Description: Ga Min breaks the curfew that he promised because of Se Hyun, and his mom tries to transfer him to another school. Han Kyeong and the study group, who can’t give up on Ga Min, persistently chase after Ga Min’s mom and try to persuade her. But that’s when the reserves of the Yeonbaek Gang barge in after finding out about Han Kyeong’s plan for Pi Han Wul.

Episodes.Title: Kim Sun Cheol Going to Prison
Episodes.Description: Ga Min runs into Pi Han Ul’s bodyguard, Kim Sun Cheol, at the hospital where his mother is hospitalized. Sun Cheol was working for Pi Han Ul because he needed to take care of his sick grandfather. In order to pay his grandfather’s hospital bills, Kim Sun Cheol decides to go to prison on the false charge of murder instead of Yeonbaek Gang. Ga Min finds out and steps forward to help Sun Cheol with his friends.

Episodes.Title: Midterm Exam
Episodes.Description: The Study Group sneaks into the Reserves General Meeting and struggles against the Yeonbaek Gang. Pi Han Ul forces Kim Sun Cheol to make a false confession to Detective Na Tae Man. Meanwhile, the fated midterm exam finally begins. The Study Group must improve their grades and climb up at least ten places to hold a disciplinary committee against Pi Han Ul. Will they all succeed?

Episodes.Title: School Violence Committee
Episodes.Description: The Student Council Committee will summon Han Ul, and Han Ul’s past is revealed. Han Ul comes up with a scheme to stop the committee. He makes fake news and puts it online to make it go viral. Because of this, the study group members are falsely accused of a school gang. Han Kyeong must make a choice to protect her students.

Episodes.Title: The Last Fight
Episodes.Description: The study group members find out about the incident Han Ul was involved in a year ago and why he is so obsessed with the school gang. Since it might put Han Kyeong in danger, the members try to come up with a solution to get through this crisis. Meanwhile, Han Kyeong tries to persuade the Vice Principal to stand with her, but she gets in danger instead.

Title: Solo Leveling
Description: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

Episodes.Title: I'm Used to It
Episodes.Description: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

Episodes.Title: If I Had One More Chance
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

Episodes.Title: It's Like a Game
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

Episodes.Title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
Episodes.Description: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

Episodes.Title: A Pretty Good Deal
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

Episodes.Title: The Real Hunt Begins
Episodes.Description: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

Episodes.Title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
Episodes.Description: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

Episodes.Title: This Is Frustrating
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

Episodes.Title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
Episodes.Description: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

Episodes.Title: What Is This, a Picnic?
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

Episodes.Title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
Episodes.Description: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

Episodes.Title: Arise
Episodes.Description: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

Episodes.Title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
Episodes.Description: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

Episodes.Title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
Episodes.Description: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

Episodes.Title: Still a Long Way to Go
Episodes.Description: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

Episodes.Title: I Need to Stop Faking
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

Episodes.Title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
Episodes.Description: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

Episodes.Title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
Episodes.Description: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

Episodes.Title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
Episodes.Description: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

Episodes.Title: It Was All Worth It
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

Episodes.Title: We Need a Hero
Episodes.Description: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

Episodes.Title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
Episodes.Description: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

Episodes.Title: Are You the King of Humans
Episodes.Description: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

Episodes.Title: On to the Next Target
Episodes.Description: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

Title: Welcome to Waikiki
Description: Kang Dong-Goo dreams of becoming a movie director, but he is cynical due to bad luck. Cheon Joon-Ki wanted to follow in his father's footsteps and become an actor, but he is now just a minor actor. Bong-Doo-Sik came to Seoul to become a scenario writer, but things have not been easy for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Three young men running a guesthouse make a shocking discovery in one of their rooms. Later, one of them, a newbie actor, begins filming with his idol.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Han Yun-a's attempt to prove her worth to the household backfires. A filming delay forces Lee Jun-ki to live in scary costume makeup for 24 hours.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kang Seo-jin learns that her crush is just as imperfect as she is. Jun-ki makes a painful sacrifice for a movie role. Yun-a reveals her life's dream.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: An embarrassing photo of Jun-ki goes viral, but leads to an opportunity. Yun-a tells her housemates about her past. Seo-jin interviews for a job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A text message mishap threatens Bong Du-sik's chances with a new crush. Yun-a and Kang Dong-gu get the flu and are quarantined in a tent.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: A fellow culinary student takes an interest in Yun-a. To buy more time to pay the rent, Jun-ki tells a lie that snowballs into a sudden engagement.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Misfortune brings Min Su-a to the guesthouse. Du-sik runs into his first love. Desperate to pay back the landlady, Jun-ki accepts a questionable job.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: As Du-sik tries to express his feelings to Yun Mal-geum, Dong-gu struggles to hide his from Yun-a. To earn cash, Jun-ki tries his hand at meokbang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Dong-gu runs into problems while babysitting Han Sol. After hurting Seo-jin's chance at getting a journalism job, Jun-ki sets out to make things right.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Seo-jin and Jun-ki agonize over what happened the previous evening -- but for totally different reasons. Dong-gu comes to a realization about Yun-a.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Yun-a leaves Dong-gu with more questions than answers. Jun-ki hides from a UFC fighter whose girlfriend he stole. Su-a's undercover work pays off.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jun-ki tries to view Seo-jin as a woman, but memories of her as a girl get in the way. A jealous Dong-gu challenges Song Hyeon-jun to a duel of sorts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Su-a ropes Du-sik into helping her launch an online shopping mall. From a distance, Dong-gu spots his sister kissing a man, and demands to meet him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jun-ki and a co-worker compete to star in a commercial. Du-sik helps Su-a practice her driving skills. Dong-gu gets a lunch date with Yun-a.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: While Seo-jin and Jun-ki secretly go on a weekend getaway together, the rest of the Waikiki crew visit another guesthouse to get ideas for their own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: When Dong-gu refuses to speak to his sister, she declares she's going on a shaving strike until he does. Hyeon-jun has something to tell Yun-a.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Dong-gu and Yun-a go on their first official date. A romantic declaration that Du-sik makes to a new Ukrainian houseguest gets lost in translation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: An obsessed fan begins to stalk Jun-ki. Dong-gu and Yun-a struggle to have their first kiss. Su-a gives Du-sik good -- and bad -- dating advice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Su-a starts her own fashion line. Jun-ki is given a publicity stunt to perform -- involving a pole dance. Yun-a meets her idol, a rapper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Sol's father begs Yun-a to forgive him. Seo-jin asks Jun-ki for time to reconsider their relationship. Su-a makes a confession to Du-sik.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A struggling actor, an aspiring singer and a baseball hopeful scramble to keep their guesthouse afloat after an unlucky blow from Mother Nature.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Caught between two women, Cha U-sik comes up with a rather sloppy plan to impress one and avoid the other. Lee Jun-ki faces a major acting challenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Han Su-yeon jumps into the job market. Kook Ki-bong and Jun-ki try to promote their guesthouse by appearing on TV.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ki-bong suffers the consequences of letting Cha Yu-ri in the house, while poor U-sik spirals out of control as old feelings creep back into his heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Su-yeon sets U-sik up for a blind date. But could this be a trap? Jun-ki and Ki-bong battle for the ownership rights to ... a blanket.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: In an effort to protect their friends' feelings, U-sik and Jun-ki hide the truth and bear the heavy burden of silence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jun-ki immerses himself in the world of his character. U-sik's attempt to help Su-yeon keep her job gets slightly out of hand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: An invitation to a birthday party puts U-sik's life in jeopardy. Ki-bong seeks comfort in a box of chocolates.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Kim Jeong-eun finds it hard to admit her feelings for a longtime friend. Su-yeon meets a speech coach with an unfortunate habit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: A quiz show awakens Yu-ri's competitive side. Jun-ki's sudden rise to stardom comes at a price as young fans keep a watchful eye on him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jun-ki seeks the help of a professional to bring Rebecca back to life. U-sik jumps through impossible hoops to confess his feelings to a friend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ki-bong's search for employment continues in blissful ignorance. Jun-ki's inability to remember the name of a classmate takes him down a rabbit hole.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: An exciting opportunity comes knocking, but a moral dilemma keeps Jun-ki from taking the job. Ki-bong finds himself unable to get out of bed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: In an effort to cheer up a friend, Jeong-eun spills her deepest, darkest secrets. Yu-ri and Ki-bong's first date gets off on the wrong foot.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Jun-ki learns to develop feelings for an acting partner. Su-yeon prepares a pitch for a new show, while unsettling feelings of jealousy distract her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Terrible timing keeps Su-yeon from coming clean to her crush. U-sik discovers that there is more to Yu-ri and Ki-bong's relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Terrible timing keeps Su-yeon from coming clean to her crush. U-sik discovers that there is more to Yu-ri and Ki-bong's relationship.

Title: Hidden Love
Description: Since high school, Sang Zhi has had a crush on Duan Jiaxu. When fate brings them together again, they find a chance to embark on a sweet relationship.

Episodes.Title: I Have Been Waiting. A Secret Kept
Episodes.Description: While trying to find someone to accompany her to parent-teacher meetings, a mischievous Sang Zhi develops a crush on her brother's friend, Duan Jiaxu.

Episodes.Title: Get Closer. What Made Me Meet Someone Like You
Episodes.Description: Seeing Duan Jiaxu again triggers a long-buried memory for Sang Zhi. Later, Duan Jiaxu steps up to support her during a time of personal crisis.

Episodes.Title: Deemed. Get a Little Closer
Episodes.Description: A chance encounter at a dessert shop brings Sang Zhi and Jiaxu closer. Soon after, Sang Zhi faces an awkward love confession from a birthday boy.

Episodes.Title: Keeping a Secret
Episodes.Description: Seeing Sang Zhi's distress, Jiaxu decides to teach her bullies a lesson. Meanwhile, a decline in Sang Zhi's grades leads to the search for a tutor.

Episodes.Title: In Secret. The Name Engraved in My Heart
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi gets an unexpected tutor to improve her grades. In an effort to spark her interest in school, Jiaxu takes Sang Zhi on a field trip.

Episodes.Title: Distance. When There's You in Another City
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi prepares a surprise gift for Jiaxu on New Year's Eve. But while alone at school, Jiaxu receives a shocking phone call from his family.

Episodes.Title: Promise The Little Things That Matter
Episodes.Description: Jiaxu confides in Sang Zhi about what's on his mind. In the new semester, Sang Zhi travels to Jiaxu's city and uncovers a heartbreaking revelation.

Episodes.Title: Re-encounter. Say See You Again Before Meeting Again
Episodes.Description: Leaving her heartbreak behind, Sang Zhi embarks on the next chapter of her life. However, Jiaxu unexpectedly enters her life once again.

Episodes.Title: Subcurrent. I Can't Help But Fall In Love
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi asks Jiaxu out for old times' sake, but an emergency derails their plans. Soon after, more details about Jiaxu's struggles begin to surface.

Episodes.Title: Joke. Give Me a Reason To Forget
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi tries to take care of Jiaxu as he recovers from his ailment, but making him take a break from work proves to be harder than she anticipated.

Episodes.Title: Moved. If That's Love
Episodes.Description: After a dinner with Sang Zhi gets interrupted by an unexpected guest, Jiaxu is compelled to revisit a family tragedy from years ago.

Episodes.Title: Courage. If I Could
Episodes.Description: Caught in a bad mood, Sang Zhi drinks more than she can handle at a post-exam hangout. Fortunately, Jiaxu is there to take care of her.

Episodes.Title: Feeling You. I Think You're Falling In Love Too
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi returns home for the school break. Meanwhile, she and Jiaxu try to carefully figure out whether they have feelings for each other.

Episodes.Title: Connection. The Most Beautiful Wait
Episodes.Description: A longtime friend helps Sang Zhi address her concerns about Jiaxu. With newfound courage, they anxiously embark on their first date.

Episodes.Title: Confession. Attraction
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi's roommates try to coach her in romance. Later, on her birthday, Sang Zhi finally gets the answer she's been waiting for.

Episodes.Title: Feelings. Waiting For Your Date
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi lies to Sang Yan about her current relationship. And after being stood up a few times, she grows worried about Jiaxu's feelings for her.

Episodes.Title: Fallen. I Want Us to Be Together
Episodes.Description: Duan Jiaxu's birthday is quickly approaching. At the romantic dinner Sang Zhi carefully curated, the two make an important decision.

Episodes.Title: Captivated. The Taste of First Love
Episodes.Description: After a power outage, Sang Zhi heads to Jiaxu's place to study for an exam, but she finds it difficult to adjust to her new role as his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Lean in Close. The Rhythm of Happiness
Episodes.Description: After a family fight, Sang Zhi begins her internship but soon faces a series of troubles. Luckily, Jiaxu offers his support during this tough time.

Episodes.Title: Safeguard. One Path, Two People
Episodes.Description: Jiang Ying opens up about a tragedy from the past. Later, Sang Zhi and Jiaxu realize it's no longer possible to hide their relationship from Sang Yan.

Episodes.Title: Relying on You. I Am Because You Are
Episodes.Description: After a heartfelt exchange, Sang Yan gives his blessings to Jiaxu. Meanwhile, Sang Zhi's daring proposal at a work meeting lands her in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Romance. To See the Stars With You
Episodes.Description: As Sang Zhi's internship comes to a close, she plans a special holiday with Jiaxu. But her parents begin to notice something odd about their daughter.

Episodes.Title: Stranded, but Love Is Persistent
Episodes.Description: Li Ping warns Sang Zhi about Duan Jiaxu's family issues, and Jiaxu must face a serious conversation with Sang Zhi's father.

Episodes.Title: Set Off. So Near and Yet So Far
Episodes.Description: Sang Zhi's heartfelt confession brings her and Jiaxu closer. Following a long-awaited family reconciliation, Jiaxu starts a new chapter in his life.

Episodes.Title: Rush. Can't Hide Secretly
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win over Sang Zhi's parents, Jiaxu engages in an earnest talk with them. As Sang Zhi's graduation draws close, Jiaxu has a big surprise ready.

Title: True Beauty
Description: After being bullied and discriminated because of her ugly looks, a high school girl transforms herself into a gorgeous "goddess" and quickly rises to fame after mastering the art of makeup via online tutorial videos.

Episodes.Title: The Errand Girl
Episodes.Description: Kids hate her just because she’s ugly. And for the same reason, her crush cruelly rejects her confession. Thinking of ending her life, Ju Kyung stands at the edge of a rooftop. That’s when Su Ho jumps in to save her. Days later, Ju Kyung comes across some makeup techniques, and she can’t believe her own eyes. On her first day as a transfer student, kids are captivated by Ju Kyung’s looks.

Episodes.Title: With or Without Make-Up
Episodes.Description: As soon as Su Ho sees Ju Kyung at the comic book store, he recognizes that it’s the same girl he saw on the rooftop. He’s kind of disappointed that she doesn’t seem to remember him. Ju Kyung is anxious to see how Su Ho will react at school the next day, but strangely he doesn’t seem to recognize her at all.

Episodes.Title: Revenge Is a Dish Best Served Cold
Episodes.Description: It seems Su Ho knows that the no makeup Ju Kyung at the comic store is the same person as the made up Ju Kyung at school. Ju Kyung feels anxious that he might tell everyone about how ugly she actually is. She promises him that she’ll do anything he asks, but it starts to wear her out.

Episodes.Title: Ju Kyung Goes on a Blind Date
