Episodes.Description: Asta and Noelle are captured along with Nero and they head toward the strong magic region near the border when Captain Yami and Magna arrive. Captain Fuegoleon and Captain Nozel also show up, causing the Devil Believers to panic. The captains try to talk to the Devil Believers, but their distrust for them is just too strong. The Devil Believers try to bring their powers together in order to face the Magic Knight captains.

Episodes.Title: Two Things to Look for
Episodes.Description: The incident with the Devil Believers had come to a close. This whole incident ends up hurting Nero, who witnessed the pain the Devil Believers felt from having less mana and reminds her of her time with the first Wizard King, Lumiere and the magic item he was trying to create to get rid of discrimination in their kingdom. She then gets summoned by Julius. Meanwhile, Asta and the others receive a message saying that the Heart Kingdom and the Spirit Guardians were ready to train them for their fight against the devil.

Episodes.Title: The Maidens’ Challenge
Episodes.Description: To prepare for the upcoming battle against the devil, the Black Bull Grey decided that she needed to get over her shyness and be able to face her friends first before anything else, so she asked Noelle to mentor her. However, things aren’t going very well. Next, Grey tries to get Gauche to help her, since they had fought together in the past. For this training, she walked around town with him when it was crowded, but then they saw a panicked Charlotte run by.

Episodes.Title: Clash! The Battle of the Magic Knights Squad Captains
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knight Squad Captains end up doing a team battle due to Julius’ suggestion. Since the citizens are still weary after the attack by the Eye of the Midnight Sun, they want to prove that they still mean to protect the kingdom and its citizens. The Magic Knights watch in anticipation as their captains split up into two teams and go all out in this battle.

Episodes.Title: To Tomorrow!
Episodes.Description: Asta and Noelle go to see the Magic Knight Entrance Exams with Yami. The testing site and the anti-birds that gather there are rather nostalgic to Asta and remembers his own experience at the exams last year after seeing the hopefuls from this year.

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: The Magic Knight Squad Captains gather for a meeting and for an award ceremony with the king later. At the meeting, they decide that Asta, Nero, Noelle, Luck, Finral, Mimosa, Leopold, Charlotte and Rill will be going to the Heart Kingdom to train with the Spirit Guardians. At the award ceremony, Yuno advances very quickly in rank.

Episodes.Title: Vice Captain Langris Vaude
Episodes.Description: Though Vangeance, the Captain of the Golden Dawn, had asked Langris to return to his duties as vice captain, he continues to distance himself from the squad. Yuno had suddenly moved up all the ranks at a decoration ceremony and Langris asks him to fight him. The rest of the squad seems shocked, but Yuno accepts Langris’ request and fights him and they have a fierce battle. But during their fight, Yuno seems to have some doubts with how Langris is fighting.

Episodes.Title: The 5 Spirit Guardians
Episodes.Description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus. However, as they grew up, some differences between them became plain. Yuno was a genius with magic, with amazing power and control, while Asta could not use magic at all, and tried to make up for his lack by training physically. When they received their Grimoires at age 15, Yuno got a spectacular book with a four-leaf clover (most people receive a three-leaf-clover), while Asta received nothing at all. However, when Yuno was threatened, the truth about Asta’s power was revealed, he received a five-leaf clover Grimoire, a “black clover”! Now the two friends are heading out in the world, both seeking the same goal!

Episodes.Title: Awakening Powers
Episodes.Description: While Asta and the others were training in the Heart Kingdom, back in the Clover Kingdom, Yami asked Mereoleona to help him train. They start their training immediately and Yami is no match against Mereoleona who is a master at using Mana Zone. Meanwhile, the Spade Kingdom’s forces continues to draw nearer as it continues its invasion.

Episodes.Title: Five-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Months after arriving at the Heart Kingdom, Asta still doesn’t have any magic, but he’s become more powerful at an alarming speed due to his training with the Spirit Guardians. Anti-magic is one of the magic attributes that falls into the “Arcane Stage” and is needed to defeat the devil. And because of that, Gaja asks Asta how exactly he obtained the five-leaf grimoire.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Hope and Despair
Episodes.Description: The Spade Kingdom successfully takes over the Diamond Kingdom and then sets their sights on the Clover Kingdom and Heart Kingdom. The Spade Kingdom troops get through the strong magic region using a mobile fortress which sucks up the mana of the Spade Kingdom citizens who were taken by force. But then Asta, who had finished his training with the Spirit Guardians, comes to the rescue! Meanwhile, Luck and Leopold head to the Spade Kingdom in order to try to take over one of their bases.

Episodes.Title: Quiet Lakes and Forest Shadows
Episodes.Description: For some reason, Charmy, who had tagged along with Asta and the others to train in the Heart Kingdom, keeps trying to eat up all of the food in the Heart Kingdom. Asta tries to take her back and goes to the forest Charmy is last seen. However, Charmy had also trained with the Spirit Guardians and had become even more powerful. Meanwhile, Yuno is contacted by Sister Lily and heads back to his home village of Hage.

Episodes.Title: The Messenger from the Spade Kingdom
Episodes.Description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned in front of the church in Hage Village, a village in the outskirts of the Clover Kingdom. And now, we finally find out the truth behind Yuno’s birth! Meanwhile, while Vice Captain Yuno was away, the Golden Dawn’s headquarters was attacked by the Spade Kingdom. Despite being the most powerful squad out of the Magic Knights, they might have finally met their match.

Episodes.Title: Zenon’s Power
Episodes.Description: After hearing about the Golden Dawn members being in trouble, Yuno hurries back. When he returned, their headquarters had been destroyed and many of the squad members were near death. Yuno’s rage explodes. Meanwhile, the members who can still fight are doing their best to hold up against the attackers that includes one of the members of the Dark Triade, Zenon, and his minions.

Episodes.Title: The Great War Breaks Out
Episodes.Description: The War against the Spade Kingdom begins in earnest as the Heart Kingdom and Black Bulls come under attack by Dante and Vanica of the Dark Triad.

Episodes.Title: Dante vs. the Captain of the Black Bulls
Episodes.Description: Grey reminisces on her past. Meanwhile the fight between Dante and Asta is continuing!

Episodes.Title: Battlefield: Heart Kingdom
Episodes.Description: Yami strikes Dante what should have been a mortal blow, but he recovers quickly with the Power of his Devil. Asta witnesses his own Devil seethe in frenzy. In the Heart Kingdom, Charmy and Leo battle more Dark Disciples.

Episodes.Title: Water Crusade
Episodes.Description: Vanica has arrived to kill the Queen of the Heart Kingdom and revealed their plan to unleash an army of demons into the world. Thanks to Megicula’s curse magic Vanica has restored to full strength all the Dark Disciples everyone had fought so hard to defeat. But Noelle, Mimosa, and Nero will push past their limits and show the results of their long training; For Aceir Silva, for the world, and for their precious friend, Lolopechka.

Episodes.Title: Captain: Yami Sukehiro
Episodes.Description: As the situation in the Heart Kingdom deteriorates beyond belief,  Captain Yami Sukehiro pushes past his limits.

Episodes.Title: Black Oath
Episodes.Description: As the battles in the Heart Kingdom begin to come to an end, Asta and Yami decide to work together as they continue in their fight against Dante Zogratis of the Dark Triad.

Episodes.Title: Stirrings of the Strongest
Episodes.Description: Yami and Vangeance are taken to the Spade Kingdom so that the ritual to open the gate to the underworld can begin. Despite how hurt he is, Asta tries to escape the infirmary to go and save Yami, however he is stopped by a mage named Nacht Faust, who also happens to be a devil-possessed. He offers to show Asta how to use his devil powers even better. Meanwhile, the Magic Knight Squad Captains hold an emergency meeting. The Golden Dawn has almost been completely annihilated, and Yuno shows up to the meeting, showing new resolve.

Episodes.Title: The Devil-Binding Ritual
Episodes.Description: Noelle and the others were involved in the explosion that Vanica caused back in the Heart Kingdom and were left unconscious. When they woke up, they found themselves in the new home of the elves that was located in a strong magic region just beyond the Heart Kingdom. There, Noelle has an unexpected reunion.

Episodes.Title: The Faraway Future
Episodes.Description: Due to Nacht's spell, the Devil who has been granting Asta power since the beginning has appeared physically. To master his Devil powers, Asta must battle and defeat his Devil, and force him to submit. But Asta has other plans... Meanwhile, Yuno, Noelle, and the others grow stronger in order to take their revenge against the Dark Triad.

Title: Fireworks of My Heart
Description: Fire chief Song Yan and emergency doctor Xu Qin were separated by family opposition when they were younger. Now ten years later, they meet again due to their professions. After experiencing life and death together, they manage to find their way back, working together and encouraging each other. They acknowledge each other's individual growth after years apart, but will they be able to overcome the obstacles in their path this time to stay together?

Episodes.Title: Long Time No See
Episodes.Description: The Shili Tai Fire and Rescue Station is in a festive scene. Suddenly the alarm rang, and firefighters were dispatched immediately. In the early morning, ER doctor Xu Qin had just returned from the emergency room after a major operation. A few firefighters covered in mud rushed in, begging her to treat his comrade who has a toothache. When she told the man to remove his mask, the man turned away and left the emergency room.

Episodes.Title: Under The Same Roof
Episodes.Description: Song Yan was called to the Captain's Office. The team received complaints. Thanks to the persuasion from the staff officer, Song Yan got out of the siege. In the locker room, several colleagues were talking about Xu Qin, and it was rumored that she was the next person to be promoted. It was said that Xu Qin's family had an unusual background, and her colleagues were stunned. Xu Qin encountered a traffic accident on the way off from work, Xu Qin stopped immediately and prepared to enter the scene.

Episodes.Title: Revival
Episodes.Description: Song Yan came back from a mission and couldn't find the lighter, he ran to the garbage station to look for it. Song Yan told Suo Jun that the two had broken up due to family issues. Suo Jun comforted him. Xu Qin and Meng Yanchen came to the bar opened by Xiao Yixiao. After hearing that the fire department came to do a fire inspection, Xu Qin thought she could see Song Yan and ran out immediately. Seeing that Song Yan was not the one who came to check, Xu Qin felt depressed.

Episodes.Title: I Still Have You in My Heart
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin learned that Song Yan was on vacation. So she came to his aunt's house again, hoping to reconcile with him. Song Yan refused. In the fire station, Song Yan complained to Suo Jun about the poor performance of the recruits. Song Yan firmly believed that he and Suo Jun could turn Shili Tai into the best fire station in the country. Suo Jun dodged his eyes.

Episodes.Title: Risk of Infection
Episodes.Description: The driver who caused the accident surived, but the HIV-positive result of the blood test made everyone break out in a cold sweat. Not only were the doctors and nurses involved in the rescue at risk of infection, but the firefighters involved in the rescue that day were more likely to be infected. Xu Qin called the fire station, and all firefighters who participated in the rescue and were injured had to be checked. Xu Qin was worried and drew blood for Song Yan.

Episodes.Title: Home Accident
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin was awakened by knocking on the door. It turned out a child's hand was stuck in the anti-theft fence of the balcony upstairs. Song Yan led the firefighters to launch a rescue from the balcony of Xu Qin's house. The child was saved. After the firefighters completed their task and extracted, Song Yan turned back, which surprised Xu Qin.

Episodes.Title: Stayed The Same
Episodes.Description: Song Yan mistakenly thought it was his younger sister who came to bring him clothes and went out immediately. When the other firefighters heard that it was the female doctor Song Yan knows, they couldn't help but hide behind and peek. Xu Qin asked Song Yan to invite her to dinner, Song Yan reluctantly agreed. The two prepared for the date and came to a fried chicken shop they used to visit in high school. Time brings the two back to ten years ago.

Episodes.Title: My Closest Comrade
Episodes.Description: Suo Jun told Song Yan about his difficulty, and Song Yan finally understood why Suo Jun wanted to be transferred. Suo Jun also advised Song Yan to get married soon. The two settled their suspicions. Looking at the honors of the fire station and listened to the thanks of the girl he saved, he tore up the transfer application he had written.

Episodes.Title: Warning
Episodes.Description: Fu Wenying learns that Xu Qin doesn’t go on a date because of her busy work, and needs her to change her job. Xu Qin confesses that she has someone she likes. Fu Wenying warns Xu Qin not to force herself to be a villain again.

Episodes.Title: Back to The Square One
Episodes.Description: Due to her mother's strict discipline, Xu Qin hasn’t dared to disobey her mother since she was a child. Although she is independent now, she is still stressed and afraid of facing her mother. She asks Song Yan to come out. Song Yan already knows she is in a dilemma before she speaks. Therefore, Song Yan agrees to go back to  square one.

Episodes.Title: Tamed Beast
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin speaks her mind to Meng Yanchen. She thinks she has been like a tame beast since she was a kid so she didn't dare to resist her mother and also doesn’t know what love is. Meng Yanchen proposes to her to go abroad with him but she refuses.

Episodes.Title: Meaningless Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: In order to speed up the replacement of old teammates and new blood, Jiang Yu proposes an idea to Song Yan but he disagrees with him. Song Yan thinks a fire scene is extremely dangerous and the new blood don’t have enough experience so they only are the reserves. Jiang Yu just wishes to avoid more meaningless sacrifices between the firefighters.

Episodes.Title: You're Not Her Brother
Episodes.Description: Meng Yanchen finds Xu Qin in the hospital, and he meets Song Yan by chance. He warns Song Yan to keep his distance from Xu Qin. Song Yan understands what he means and tells him not to interfere with Xu Qin’s life since he is not her biological brother. Meng Yanchen advises her not to end the relationship with her family because of Song Yan.

Episodes.Title: A Blind Date
Episodes.Description: Since Xu Qin is reluctant to go on the blind date arranged by her mother, she arranges for the parents of both parties to meet. Xu Qin tells Jiang Yu that she has a crush on a man. He promises to help her.

Episodes.Title: A Thankless Job
Episodes.Description: A few college backpackers are stuck in a mountain and needed rescuing. Even the local civilian rescue team goes missing after looking for them. Without knowing the exact location, the firefighters face a tough rescue with the weather conditions and terrain. Meanwhile, Xu Qin receives a lesson on reading patients, not just treating them.

Episodes.Title: Setting Up a Joint Rescue Team
Episodes.Description: Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station proposes a joint rescue effort with the city's First People's Hospital. Xu Qin volunteers to join the training. At the fire station, both firefighters and medical staff learn from one another to improve the efficiency and efficacy of rescue operations.

Episodes.Title: Duality
Episodes.Description: After a bus flips over, a passenger named Chen Yu rescues many people before the firefighters arrive, but he is thrown out of the bus when it falls off a cliff and is seriously injured. He is called a hero by everyone, but he has an unknown side to him. Meanwhile, after the rescue, reporters want to interview Song Yan, but he introduces Xu Qin as the rescue team leader and gives the opportunity to her instead.

Episodes.Title: Dignity
Episodes.Description: Jiang Yu and Li Meng went to a fire scene for a second inspection, but found some problems. The person in charge of the warehouse called a group of hooligans to beat them up but the firefighters can't fight or talk back, so they felt down in the dumps. Song Yan figured out a way to resolve their grievances, and they trained even harder.

Episodes.Title: Gifts
Episodes.Description: Wu Xuan Yang calls 119 to rescue him and his alpaca, but Dr. Xu discovers that he has a serious condition called aortic dissection. His family doubts Dr. Xu's diagnosis but ends up being thankful to her for saving him. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin exchange gifts with one another.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin's mom discovers about Xu Qin staying the fire station. She goes to Song Yan to tell him to stop seeing Xu Qin. However, Xu Qin tries to rekindle with Song Yan who shuts her down in return. Later, they get into an argument about the mission of public servants.

Episodes.Title: Drill
Episodes.Description: With the medical staff gone from the fire station, Song Yan misses Xu Qin even though he refuses to admit it. However, a fire drill at the hospital reunites them again. Meanwhile, Dr. Xu contemplates her profession.

Episodes.Title: Rescue Team
Episodes.Description: Teams are organized to help with the disaster rescue of earthquake victims in Wangxiang. The place is in bad shape, with many collapsed houses and structures and missing people. That includes Jiang Yi's mom, who's in Wangxiang with her sister, Jiang Yi's aunt.

Episodes.Title: Missing
Episodes.Description: Meng Yan Chen's mom wants her son and husband to let people know about the help they've been giving to disaster relief. Meanwhile, Song Yan and Xu Qin are both exhausted from the disaster rescue. Then, Song Yan gets seriously injured.

Episodes.Title: Duty
Episodes.Description: Despite knowing Song Yan's life is in danger, Xu Qin chooses not to stay by his side and continues fulfilling her duty as a doctor. The firefighters continue doing their mission in earthquake relief. Later, Xu Qin and Jiang Yi receive news that put their mind at ease.

Episodes.Title: Falling into Place
Episodes.Description: After the successful disaster relief operation, Song Yan and Xu Qin go back to their lives. However, they can't continue setting aside their feelings for each other anymore. Things are beginning to fall into place, even in Dr. Xu's work.

Episodes.Title: Overcoming Trauma
Episodes.Description: Some firefighters struggle to get over their traumatic experience after providing the disaster relief at Wangxiang and are forced to overcome their anxiety by Yang Chi. Xu Qin is annoyed that Song Yan doesn't contact her for a day and doubts their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Caterpillars
Episodes.Description: Meng Yan Chen finds out that Song Yan and Xu Qin are back together and tries to discourage Song Yan from being with her. He feels like he's been abandoned since Xu Qin went to find her happiness. Meanwhile, Xu Qin has learned to appreciate the process even if there might be no good outcome.

Episodes.Title: Staying Together
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin confesses to her parents that she is dating Song Yan who highly disapprove of their relationship. As a result, she moves out from home into Song Yan's. His aunt and uncle welcome her happily.

Episodes.Title: Progress
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin is welcomed warmly in the home of Song Yan's uncle and aunt. Xu Qin wants Meng Yan Chen to speak to their mom for her, but he refuses. Meanwhile, things seem to be progressing between Meng Yan Chen and Ye Zi.

Episodes.Title: Assurance
Episodes.Description: Yan Chen tries to persuade his mom to let Xu Qin live her life, btu she doesn't back down. She invites Xu Qin to go shopping with her as a pretense to introduce her to another guy. Later, a mother and son threatens to jump off the hospital building Xu Qin works at.

Episodes.Title: Danger
Episodes.Description: There's a cyanide leak at an electroplating plant. Firefighters are dispatched to save the three workers who have been poisoned and resolve the issue. However, Song Yan also gets poisoned during the process.

Episodes.Title: New Year
Episodes.Description: Song Yan tells Xu Qin his future plans for them. Everyone is busy preparing and celebrating New Year, but the firefighters are still on duty to protect people. Xu Qin also goes home to visit her family for New Year.

Episodes.Title: Flashover
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin is having a difficult time because her mom is interfering with her work at the hospital. Meanwhile, Song Yan is preparing for his transfer. However, a huge fire breaks out with a flashover that endangers the firefighters' lives.

Episodes.Title: Making Choices
Episodes.Description: A life is lost in the fire at Junguang Square, which is owned by Guokun Group. Song Yan has to decide whether to report about the truth of the fire which caused a death of his comrade. However, that decision will sow more discord between him and Xu Qin's family.

Episodes.Title: New Developments
Episodes.Description: Song Yan is being suspended from work due to accusations of bribery. A new development in Shilitai Fire and Rescue Station also makes Song Yan's decision to transfer waver. And Xu Qin starts asking for explanations of things that happened in the past.

Episodes.Title: Gunshot Truth
Episodes.Description: A patient at the hospital gets worked up and injures Xu Qin's wrist. Meanwhile, despite being in an argument over his past, Song Yan still does not want to tell Xu Qin how he got his gunshot wound. Zhai Miao is worried for him and goes to see Xu Qin to help patch up their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Accusations
Episodes.Description: Xu Qin finds out what her family did to Song Yan and confronts her parents. Meanwhile, Meng Yan Chen frankly tells Ye Zi his thoughts about her and makes her angry. So she comes up with a plan to take revenge on him.

Episodes.Title: An Eye for an Eye
Episodes.Description: Zhai Miao holds the evidence to prove Yan Chen's innocence. The choice is in her hands whether to give it up and help the Meng family that ruined Song Yan's life, or do the same and destroy the Meng family.

Episodes.Title: Typhoon
Episodes.Description: Song Yan and Xu Qin are busy working with little time to prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, a super typhoon makes landfall in Yancheng and causes many people to be trapped or injured. Both the firefighters and medical staff have their hands full to help the people of Yancheng.

Episodes.Title: The Reaching Hand
Episodes.Description: A typhoon causes disasters in the city. Floods and fallen trees slow down Xu Qin and Song Yan from rescuing civilians. At this moment, Mrs. Meng is trapped in her car under a collapsing tunnel. Will rescuers get to her in time?

Title: If Wishes Could Kill
Description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After Girigo grants Choi Hyeong-wook a wish, he introduces the app to his friends, who brush him off. But soon, his behavior grows concerning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After a sudden tragedy, Yoo Se-ah realizes Kim Geon-woo may be next and rallies her friends to find a solution. But Girigo proves too sinister to stop.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Seeking to cast out evil, Kang Ha-joon takes Se-ah to his shaman sister — sending her to a cursed space filled with fear, trauma and abandonment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ha-joon, Se-ah and Bangwool investigate Girigo's origins, chasing an online friend of Hyeong-wook's. They soon discover a house that may hold clues.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After a wild night out, Lim Na-ri discovers a terrifying truth. Soon, her jealousy takes hold of her as she navigates her feelings for Geon-woo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Born from innocence, Kwon Si-won's friendship with Do Hye-ryung — steeped in jealousy, resentment and revenge — gives rise to Girigo and the curse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Facing sabotage from spirits, the group hunts for the original phone. But as they close in on their goal, danger and darkness lurk at every turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: On the brink of defeat, Se-ah confronts the evil behind the curse. Can she stop the unending deaths once and for all?

Title: Falling Into Your Smile
Description: After joining an all-male e-sports team, an amateur gamer tests her skills and leads her team to the world championships.

Episodes.Title: Invitation
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao is asked to join a professional gaming team after passing a secret test but since there are no female gamers in the whole league she is unsure whether to join.

Episodes.Title: Official Signing
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao goes to the ZGDX headquarters to start training with the other members of the team. Her arrival gets off to a rocky start with two of the team members as well as her mother who does not approve of her career choice.

Episodes.Title: Seeking Reconciliation
Episodes.Description: Jianyang, Lu Sicheng, and Tong Yao play a game online and start love triangle rumors when the conversations are leaked and labeled as flirty. Tong Yao's parents see these rumors and start to worry about her situation.

Episodes.Title: First Victory
Episodes.Description: After winning a training match the team goes out to celebrate but when they come back to their training headquarters they find two unexpected guests waiting for them.

Episodes.Title: Mental Breakdown
Episodes.Description: After the guests leave ZGDX headquarters the team is challenged to a training competition by TAT but Lu Sicheng turns it down knowing they just want to target Tong Yao and demoralize her. Tong Yao finally does her first game on webcam.

Episodes.Title: Hateful Comments
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao and Jinyang go out to take their mind off their troubles. Tong Yao gets drunk and is escorted back to headquarters by Lu Sicheng when she meets Lu Yue an earlier ZGDX midlaner who just came off a suspension.

Episodes.Title: The Past
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao remembers the previous night and decides she can only face her team members by wearing a mask. Tong Yao sees that there is friction between the team and Lu Yue over a prior incident that involves God Ming.

Episodes.Title: Setting the Record Straight
Episodes.Description: Ai Jai gets on a Livestream and explains Brother A's intention and why Lu Yue fought him. Xiao Pang, Old K realize their mistake and make amends with Lu Yue meanwhile Lu Yue and Tang Yao continue to compete for starting position.

Episodes.Title: Official Team Photos
Episodes.Description: ZGDX arrives for their photoshoot but Lu Sicheng and Tong Yao encounter an awkward moment right before she takes her pictures. ZGDX plays YQCB and Lu Sicheng realizes that a friend from his past has come back.

Episodes.Title: Powering Through
Episodes.Description: With the first game of the National League approaching the teams to choose their opponents and groups for the competition. With this in mind ZGDX also chooses their starting midlaner.

Episodes.Title: Falling Sick
Episodes.Description: ZGDX defeats RK and a bitter Jianyang. Sicheng and Tong Yao end up taking care of each other.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: News of Tong Yao and Sicheng's sleepover is revealed during a livestream. Jianyang makes another attempt to win Tong Yao back.

Episodes.Title: Commanding Respect
Episodes.Description: ZGDX destroys their match with KING. Tong Yao steps in to comfort an opponent and tells Sicheng she wants to play TAT again.

Episodes.Title: Blind Date
Episodes.Description: With her teammates' help, Tong Yao defeats A Tai from TAT. Meanwhile, Sicheng's mom sets him up on a blind date.

Episodes.Title: Marking Territory
Episodes.Description: At the next match, Tong Yao comes under attack from FNC's Kun. Sicheng leads ZGDX to victory, but finds another competitor for Tong Yao.

Episodes.Title: A Touch of Intimacy
Episodes.Description: Su Luo buys flowers for Sicheng, who takes everyone shoe shopping. Tong Yao defeats Sicheng in a live solo match.

Episodes.Title: The Smear Campaign
Episodes.Description: Sicheng turns down Su Luo. At an anime convention, Tong Yao gets into a fight and is suspended for one game.

Episodes.Title: Secret Support
Episodes.Description: Sicheng refuses to talk to Tong Yao, but still brigs her food, prompting her to apologize. Lu Yue fills in for Tong Yao for the first time.

Episodes.Title: In the Crosshairs
Episodes.Description: After Tong Yao's cat eats one of Sicheng's goldfishes, she takes him to buy another one. Tong Yao is reinstated to pay.

Episodes.Title: Love Confession
Episodes.Description: Although ZGDX wins their next match, Tong Yao is disappointed by the industry as she is targeted by the opposing players for her gender.

Episodes.Title: Dating
Episodes.Description: Sicheng confesses his feelings to Tong Yao and gives her until 9 p.m. to respond.

Episodes.Title: Making a Comeback
Episodes.Description: Chen Jinyang and Ai Jia face difficulties in their relationship after she's criticized for not showing interest in his matches.

Episodes.Title: Love Goes Public
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao and Sicheng are photographed holding hands. ZGDX attends an event in Xiamen.

Episodes.Title: Buying the Team
Episodes.Description: Jinyang persuades her father to buy YQCB and hosts an esports tournament. Tong Yao and Sicheng go public with their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Conflict
Episodes.Description: News of Tong Yao and Sicheng's relationship causes a stir. ZGDX loses a match due to Lao K and Lao Mao, but fans blame Tong Yao instead.

Episodes.Title: A Parcel of Terror
Episodes.Description: Tong Yao finally becomes the MVP, but is hurt by a mysterious package. She's forced to sit out of the next game, making Sicheng furious.

Episodes.Title: Defeated
Episodes.Description: The fan who sent the package releases a video, changing the public opinion on Tong Yao. Sicheng takes it upon himself to set things right.

Episodes.Title: Hand Injury Relapse
Episodes.Description: The team hits a low point after losing a key match. Sicheng reveals what he's been up to.

Episodes.Title: Advancing to the Top Four
Episodes.Description: Sicheng accompanies Tong Yao to meet her parents. ZGDX participates in a new tournament, where they must face off against CK again.

Episodes.Title: Birthday Celebration
Episodes.Description: ZGDX surprises Tong Yao on her birthday and prepares to play in the nationals against YQCB.

Episodes.Title: Claiming the Crown
Episodes.Description: ZGDX puts everything on the line as they compete against YQCB to take home the title of national champions.

Title: Bloodhounds
Description: Faced with ruthless foes with a violent thirst, two young boxers band together — risking life and limb to bring justice and protect their loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After a thrilling boxing match, Kim Gun-woo befriends Hong Woo-jin. Kim Myeong-gil's business ambitions come into focus, with dangerous tactics at play.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo meets with Choi Tae-ho to remedy his mother's debt. Myeong-gil endures a humiliating meeting with Hong Min-beom and grows revengeful.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo and Woo-jin figure out how to take down the scam ring. Myeong-gil gains the upper hand on Min-beom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After the group faces a close call, President Choi plans his own operation. But as their plans fall into place, the enemies stand in their way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After narrowly escaping a threat, the group trains for what's coming — and President Choi and his men look to extract valuable information.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The group celebrates as they get ready for their next move. More exposed than ever before, Myeong-gil goes after President Choi and his guards.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After an unthinkable setback, Gun-woo and Woo-jin resolve to come back with a vengeance — later partnering with an unlikely figure.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Galvanized by their duty to their loved ones, Gun-woo and Woo-jin tread forward to take down Myeong-gil — once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Going up against a formidable champion, Kim Gun-woo prepares for an upcoming fight. But in the shadows, the brutal Im Baek-jeong hunts him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo puts his mother’s safety first. Hong Woo-jin turns to an old friend for help. But Baek-jeong's men soon catch up after tailing their every move.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo discovers just how sophisticated IKFC is — and that he could potentially get pulled in. Meanwhile, Baek-jeong finds another target to lure him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises after Baek-jeong puts Gun-woo’s close ally at risk. As Baek-jeong’s group comes to light, Min Gang-yong plans a mission to hunt him down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Backed into a corner, Gun-woo decides to face Baek-jeong himself. But things take a turn — further fueling Baek-jeong’s rage to new heights.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Gun-woo and Woo-jin zero in on what makes Baek-jeong vulnerable. Gang-yong makes a final move to capture Baek-jeong, but the task is full of danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Hong Min-beom devises a plan to end the madness for good — pitting Gun-woo and Woo-jin in a final fight against formidable foes for lasting peace.

Title: Love Between Fairy and Devil
Description: When a low-ranked fairy accidentally resurrects a powerful demon, their fates become cosmically entangled as the world is thrown into turmoil.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua is just a low-ranked fairy. But when her crush is in trouble, she makes a bold move that unwittingly leads her to face a notorious demon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Trapped in a sealed dimension, Xiao Lanhua and the infamous demon try to figure out an escape plan. Dongfang Qingcang revisits his past defeat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: With their fates cosmically linked, Dongfang Qingcang races to save Xiao Lanhua from danger. Changheng continues the search for a missing prisoner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The magic bond between the fairy and demon proves to be more powerful than expected. Oblivious to Dongfang's identity, Xiao Lanhua keeps annoying him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Dongfang Qingcang makes efforts to heal Xiao Lanhua's injury. The two grow closer as they are increasingly used to each other's company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: To get closer to Changheng, Xiao Lanhua joins a qualifying test for fairies. When a saboteur steps in, the exam goes wildly off the rails.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua's caring heart makes her a standout in the fairy exam. A chat unexpectedly stirs up Dongfang Qingcang's emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: A rejection from Changheng leaves Xiao Lanhua shattered. While fleeing from his foes, Dongfang Qingcang makes a daring move that reveals his feelings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua's connection to the wanted prisoner makes her a public enemy. When Qingcang rushes to help, he is confronted about his real identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Taken to a different world as a prisoner, Xiao Lanhua struggles to process her revelation about the real identity of Dongfang Qingcang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua's risky move puts her in a tricky situation. Assuming a new identity, she entangles herself in a series of dangerous political games.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua and Qingcang scramble to hide their secret identities. Meanwhile, Changheng's rescue plan goes horribly wrong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Stuck in an awkward situation, Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang have no choice but to face Changheng as someone else.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Jieli pays a visit to a good friend. As their bond grows deeper, Xiao Lanhua gets a glimpse of Dongfang Qingcang's tragic past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Jieli grows closer to someone who understands her upbringing. Against Qingcang's warning, Xiao Lanhua unwittingly walks into a trap.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Qingcang begins to notice a small but vital change in himself. This sudden shift brought in cruel consequences to people around him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: To find out the truth about Qingcang's childhood, Xiao Lanhua ventures into a tabooed palace and summons a deity from the past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: The father-son encounter leaves Dongfang Qingcang shattered. After revisiting his trauma, Qingcang learns to express his newfound emotions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: A shocking discovery sends Changheng to the human realm, where Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang also happen to end up in.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Several eternal beings embark on their own adventures in the human realm, where Qingcang approaches a special woman marked by a mythical seal.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua accidentally disrupts a destined encounter, leaving several people's souls in dire peril. Luckily, there are ways to remedy the situation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: As Xiao Lanhua and Dongfang Qingcang make detailed plans to clean up their mess, the fates they derailed become even more convoluted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: To assuage Xiao Run's feelings for Xiao Lanhua, Qingcang makes an abrupt announcement. A pretend couple spend some genuine good time together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Qingcang's plan is obstructed by an idea from Jieli. Meanwhile, Xiao Lanhua struggles to understand her own feelings toward two eternal beings.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Xiao Lanhua and Xie Wanqing are marrying their matches in the human realm, but a series of conspiracies end up breaking out on their big day.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: As Xiao Lanhua steps in to protect Dongfang Qingcang, her past Iife is unexpectedly revealed. Yun Zhongjun İssues a cruel order.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: After the experience in the human realm, two nemeses develop a complicated friendship. Changheng's loyalty is rewarded with a draconian punishment.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: To prove his love, Dongfang Qingcang goes through gruesome tortures for Xiao Lanhua, who also makes a daring proposal despite overwhelming objections.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Under a painful test, Xiao Lanhua proves her unwavering Conviction. Meanwhile, Xunfeng's resentment toward Xiao Lanhua builds up to a boiling point.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: In a world of illusion, an eternal being attempts to corrupt Qingcang's mind. The identity of Xiao Lanhua's past life is revealed before her eyes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Betrayed and captured, a determined Xiao Lanhua makes a tearful decision to save her loved ones at a costly price.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Mulling over his tragic loss, Dongfang Qingcang resigns himself to living in a dream dimension. Meanwhile, Changheng delivers him a message of hope.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: A tragedy reverses its course due to Qingcang's tremendous efforts. But the returned lover is nothing like whom he used to know.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Teamed up to confront a powerful enemy, two estranged siblings rebuild their bond at long last. Xiyun realizes a deviant deity is at large.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: To end his master's misery, Rong Hao resorts to an extreme act. Meanwhile, Dongfang Qingcang makes a plea to Xiyun–for old time's sake.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Qingcang and Xiao Lanhua team up to save the three realms from a deviant god, but one of them must pay the ultimate price.

Title: Mr. Queen
Description: A modern chef suddenly becomes trapped inside the body of a queen from the Joseon era, which causes chaos for everyone involved.

Episodes.Title: Jang Bong Hwan in Wonderland
Episodes.Description: Bong Hwan is a successful young chef, but he finds himself in trouble. After accidentally falling into a swimming pool while being chased by the police, he wakes up in the Joseon dynasty in a woman’s body. And the body he is trapped in belongs to the future queen of all people. Bong Hwan must find a way to go back.

Episodes.Title: Nobody Knows
Episodes.Description: Bong Hwan’s life as So Yong, the queen, begins in earnest. The rigidity of the palace wears Bong Hwan out, but he runs into the woman of his dreams. The problem is that she is Jo Hwa Jin, the woman King Cheoljong is in love with. Meanwhile, the Grand Queen Dowager and Kim Jwa Geun sense that something is off with So Yong.

Episodes.Title: Sleeping With The Enemy
Episodes.Description: So Yong escapes from danger with the help of her cousin, Byeong In. Cheoljong becomes aware of the Kim clan’s movements to protect So Yong and grows suspicious of her. Meanwhile, So Yong misses modern food and decides to make it herself in the royal kitchen. She decides that she must win over the Grand Queen Dowager’s heart with food.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Knows Too Much
Episodes.Description: So Yong gets furious as she realizes it is Cheoljong who is trying to kill her. Cheoljong also assumes So Yong is planning revenge over him as O Wol, the court maid of Hwa Jin, goes missing after that.

Episodes.Title: Susceptible Heels
Episodes.Description: To save Hwa Jin, So Yong reveals the truth about the lake incident in front of everyone. Grand Queen Dowager gets angry at So Yong for ruining her plan in bringing down the Jo clan. Meanwhile, Cheoljong feels bad for So Yong as he realizes that she jumped into the lake by herself.

Episodes.Title: Between Understanding and Misunderstanding
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong saves So Yong when she jumps into the water to go back to the present day. Cheoljong starts to see So Yong differently and tries to start fresh with her. Meanwhile, So Yong is hopeless as she fails to go back even when she drowns herself in the lake. She attempts every method to get in touch with the spirit that is in Bong Hwan’s body.

Episodes.Title: Mask
Episodes.Description: After inventing delivery system in Joseon dynasty, So Yong gains motivation in her new life. However, she suddenly travels back into the body of Bong Hwan in the present day and realizes that he is in a vegetative state. Meanwhile, as the spirit of Bong Hwan left the body of So Yong, she collapses and that leaves the Palace in an uproar.

Episodes.Title: A Dangerous Relationship
Episodes.Description: When Bong Hwan wakes up in So Yong’s body again, he regains more memories of actual So Yong. He gets upset as he loses his true identity from the present day. Meanwhile, Hwa Jin feels insecure as Cheoljong visits So Yong in her family house. Hwa Jin quickly follows after him to stop Cheoljong from seeing So Yong.

Episodes.Title: Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: So Yong wants to go back to the Palace, but Cheoljong suggests staying one more day as he is still looking for the secret ledger. Cheoljong goes out to the street in disguise, and So Yong accompanies him. Meanwhile, Queen Dowager braces herself to fight Grand Queen Dowager back after she gets insulted.

Episodes.Title: Living a Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong returns to the Palace without finding the ledger. He wonders who took it away before he did. Meanwhile, So Yong tries to become a perfect queen to satisfy the Grand Queen Dowager when she returns to the Palace. Also, she starts the investiture of the Royal Concubine to hunt down the Han family.

Episodes.Title: The Unforgiven
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong appears in So Yong’s dream and So Yong is confused about her feelings. She assumes it is a side effect from travelling back and forth in time. She decides to focus on the investiture of the Royal Concubine to retrieve her true identity. Meanwhile, Cheoljong prepares for the royal banquet, but someone tries to ruin it behind his back.

Episodes.Title: Dancing on The Swor
Episodes.Description: So Yong tracks down the man who looks exactly like Secretary Han and notices his shady move in the Royal Kitchen. As she knows how much effort Cheoljong has put into the banquet, she helps him by doing what she does best. Meanwhile, Kim Jwa Geun suddenly delivers a piece of news in front of everyone to threaten Cheoljong.

Episodes.Title: There is No Tomorrow
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong gets seriously injured from the explosion and become unconscious. Kim Jwa Geun threatens So Yong again to accept his suggestion, and So Yong jumps into the lake to regain more memories. Meanwhile, Kim Jwa Geun believes that So Yong is no longer on his side as he finds out that So Yong helped Cheoljong to save the banquet.

Episodes.Title: A Woman Who Must Die To Live
Episodes.Description: So Yong gets drunk and mistaken Cheoljong for Hong Yeon. So Yong starts avoiding Cheoljong when she finds out that they spent the night together. Cheoljong gets upset because So Yong treats him harshly. Meanwhile, someone comes to see Cheoljong and tells him that So Yong is in danger.

Episodes.Title: The Crazy X In This Palace
Episodes.Description: Everyone who lives in a palace has secrets. Bong Hwan is a chef working at the Blue House in the present day. He is so talented that he can figure out one’s health conditions and even get into their mind by just observing what they pick for their side dishes. He somehow gets trapped in the body of Kim So Yong, a queen in the Joseon dynasty, and meets King Cheoljong, the two-faced king full of secrets.

Episodes.Title: All In
Episodes.Description: After Cheoljong shares about the future of Joseon he dreams of with So Yong, she decides to help Cheoljong to fulfill his dream by applying knowledge from the present day. Byeong In feels jealous as Cheoljong and So Yong become closer every day. Meanwhile, Hwa Jin decides to tell Cheoljong the truth about the well incident.

Episodes.Title: Pregnancy Is Beautiful
Episodes.Description: Everyone including Cheoljong in the palace is happy to hear about the Queen’s pregnancy. However, So Yong can’t believe that she is pregnant and is not happy about it. Cheoljong is suspicious about So Yong’s reaction and he tries to comfort her. Meanwhile, a fierce rumour also starts to spread with the news of the Queen’s pregnancy.

Episodes.Title: The Counterattack of Memories
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong leaves the Palace to protect So Yong. So Yong worries about him as he disappears without any explanation. Meanwhile, the Grand Queen Dowager regains her regency as soon as Cheoljong leaves his spot, and she brings back Kim Jwa Geun to assist her. Byeong In tries to persuade So Yong to reconcile with the Kim clan, but she rejects his suggestion.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Came Back From The Dead
Episodes.Description: So Yong runs away from the Palace to look for Cheoljong, and Byeong In chases after her. Byeong In tries to kill So Yong on the edge of a cliff. Meanwhile, the Palace is busy with the preparation of the enthronement ceremony. However, someone goes around the streets and spreads the news that the King is still alive.

Episodes.Title: My Life Without Me
Episodes.Description: Cheoljong and So Yong plans to go back to the Palace in safety while Grand Queen Dowager and Kim Jwa Geun strictly restrict the entry. However, Bong Hwan’s soul suddenly leaves So Yong’s body when she is in danger. Will they be able to stop Kim Jwa Geun before the enthronement ceremony?

Title: Happiness
Description: A new type of deadly virus spread throughout the city, and the apartment where has different social classes of people is sealed off. With the fear of the virus, and the conflicts of the different classes, the residents have to spend and survive in the new habitation.

Episodes.Title: Public Rental Apartment
Episodes.Description: Her friend from high school, Detective Jung Yi Hyun calls Sae Bom to let her know that a SOU recruit, Lee Jong Tae is involved in a murder case that just occurred. It seems Lee Jong Tae gave some sort of drug to his friend who bit off the victim’s neck and killed him. Sae Bom, who needs to work hard and earn points to qualify for the public rental apartment, goes out to get Lee Jong Tae despite Yi Hyun’s warning.

Episodes.Title: Thirsty Patients
Episodes.Description: Sae Bom finally gets to be a homeowner. At the end of all her hard work, she thought happiness was just around the corner. However, she ends up learning she might have caught a new contagion, one that causes the infected to bite people after losing their minds. Even though Sae Bom and Seung Young are under an oath of secrecy, reporters approach them with a hefty sum of money. Meanwhile, Yi Hyun and Tae Seok from the Central Disaster Countermeasures Headquarters (CDCH) join forces to find out the true nature of the disease.

Episodes.Title: Locked In
Episodes.Description: Sae Bom thinks Tae Seok is hiding something and feels uneasy about it. The new apartment is peaceful compared to the unrealistic dormitory. Sae Bom and Yi Hyun return to their everyday lives. Although it doesn't seem right, they try their best to adapt. However, late in the night, they hear a constant banging from the unit above them.

Episodes.Title: The Spread
Episodes.Description: The apartment complex gets walled up and quarantined due to Min Ji's mad person disease triggered by the Next drug. Whether they like it or not, the people living in the apartments have to stay within the walls together for a week. Sae Bom and Yi Hyun isolate the suspect Ju Hyung and provide shelter for outsiders. Meanwhile, during the joint investigation, Yi Hyun and Tae Seok discover the dealer of Next lives in Building 101.

Episodes.Title: The Outsiders
Episodes.Description: All the apartments within the complex get infected, except Building 101. The phone lines and Internet get disconnected, and they are all on their own. Sae Bom and Yi Hyun struggle with the constant conflict between the renters and owners inside the building, including the people outside. Meanwhile, their food depletes, and they are left with only one option, to go outside.

Episodes.Title: One Man’s Life
Episodes.Description: After they return from their mission of obtaining food, the people inside won't believe anything they say about what they saw. Everyone starts to doubt each other, and distrust builds up among them as they hide their true feelings. Meanwhile, the personal trainer locked up in the fitness center turns into a monster, putting fear in the people of the building.

Episodes.Title: The Intruder
Episodes.Description: An infected person enters Building 101, and once again, Building 101 is under the threat of infection. Lieutenant Colonel Han enters the apartment complex with news to tell, but Sae Bom and Yi Hyun find him suspicious. A person goes missing due to the intrusion, and those with similar interests and minds stay close together.

Episodes.Title: Countdown
Episodes.Description: The apartment complex is now without electricity. Sae Bom and Yi Hyun find traces of an infected person inside Building 101. Who could be infected? The residents suspect others of being infected and wait for the lockdown to end. Meanwhile, Tae Seok makes a decision knowing that the antibodies may be inside Sae Bom.

Episodes.Title: Dwindling Water
Episodes.Description: The residents in Building 101 suspect Sae Bom and Yi Hyun are infected and quarantine them in their unit. With them quarantined, the residents discuss what to do about them. Making matters worse is the dwindling food and water supply. If they can't get it from outside, the only choice is to take it from someone else. Meanwhile, Sae Bom and Yi Hyun figure out how to find out who is infected.

Episodes.Title: Kim Se Hoon Disappears
Episodes.Description: Kim Se Hoon, the guy on the 15th floor, goes missing. Sae Bom and Yi Hyun try to figure out why he disappeared and what he was trying to hide. The residents in the building flock to his unit and squabble over the supplies he had stashed. Meanwhile, Yi Hyun contends with his thirst and keeps Sae Bom from knowing about his infection.

Episodes.Title: Backup Power
Episodes.Description: Sae Bom and Yi Hyun fall into a crisis due to the resident representative, Oh Ju Hyung, and other residents conspiring with Andrew. Tae Seok learns that Sae Bom is in danger and tries to get her out. And Yi Hyun, who still hasn't told Sae Bom about being infected, tries to protect her any way he can. However, they end up face to face with a mob of the infected.

Episodes.Title: Happiness Is With You
Episodes.Description: Sae Bom learns that happiness is not your house but the person you are beside. And that person to her is Yi Hyun. She determines to make it back to the apartment, her house, and to where Yi Hyun would be. Dying or getting infected doesn't scare her as she tells him to wait for her.

Title: Family by Choice
Description: A youth romance about two men and woman who aren't blood related but treated each other as family during their teens and how they meet again after 10 years.

Episodes.Title: Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon Meet
Episodes.Description: A family of three moves into the Oryun Mansion Complex, and Ju-won meets San-ha, the brother she always wanted, for the first time. Despite Ju-won's eager wish to get to know him, San-ha has trouble accepting her due to his family's situation. Meanwhile, San-ha's father meets Kang Seo-hyun, a single mother with a son named Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: One Family Name
Episodes.Description: After growing up together as a family, Ju-won, San-ha, and Hae-joon go to high school together. San-ha and Hae-joon are hot with the girls, causing Ju-won to deal with the onslaught of requests from the girls to deliver their love message to them. Meanwhile, Ju-won longs to live under one family name through adoption, which the others think is absurd. Later, Hae-joon catches a suspicious man taking photos of him.

Episodes.Title: Two Fathers
Episodes.Description: A man visits Hae-joon at school and reveals that he is Hae-joon's birth father. Although Hae-joon is initially speechless, he feels relieved to learn that his father has not abandoned him. To find out more about his father, he and San-ha talk with Aunt Yi-hyun to gain insight into his father's character before meeting him in person and uncovering the reasons for his sudden return after all these years.

Episodes.Title: An Unwelcome Visitor
Episodes.Description: Ju-won feels exhilarated about going on a date with a boy who is good-looking and smart, but she soon gets disappointed by what he says to her. San-ha and his father are upset by an unwelcome visitor who reminds San-ha of memories he doesn’t want to recall. A surprise present from Hae-joon’s biological father brings about a conflict between Hae-joon and his colleague.

Episodes.Title: Hae-joon’s Birthday
Episodes.Description: With Hae-joon’s birthday around the corner, San-ha and Hae-joon get into a big fight. To help them reconcile, Ju-won plans to take them to a rail bike. However, many misunderstandings develop as Ju-won collapses from a cold, and rumours between Dal and Hae-joon spread at the school. Meanwhile, everyone gets ready as Yi-hyun plans to join the birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Visit from Hae-joon’s Mom
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon’s mother, Seo-hyun, unexpectedly visits Yoon’s Kalguksu to repay her debt, leaving Jung Jae puzzled as to what to do with it. Meanwhile, So-hee goes missing after leaving home to meet San-ha. Her disappearance reignites the unresolved conflict between Moo-sung and Jeong-hee, resulting in San-ha's decision to distance himself from the family.

Episodes.Title: The Basketball Game
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that his mother had come to pay back her debt, but did not stay long enough to see him. After CSAT, misunderstandings between San-ha, Ju-won, Hae-joon, and Dal build up as they are clueless about each other’s true feelings. Meanwhile, Hae-joon’s birth father watches his son’s basketball game and suggests he study further in the US.

Episodes.Title: Leaving the Countryside
Episodes.Description: San-ha stays in Seoul to look after his step-sister while his mother recovers from surgery. Ju-won goes to Seoul alone to surprise him without telling the rest of the family. Meanwhile back at home, Jeong-jae collapses from overworking, scaring everyone, especially Hae-joon, who makes up his mind about going to the US.

Episodes.Title: A Decade Later
Episodes.Description: Ju-won is shocked to find out both San-ha and Hae-joon have made up their mind to leave for Seoul and the US. Feeling a part of the family will be missing, she can’t help but cry. Jeong -jae also feels bad sending the boys away and feels empty in heart. Ten years passed, San-ha and Hae-joon came back as two grown-ups.

Episodes.Title: Awkward Reunion
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Hae-joon come back on Ju-won’s birthday after ten years. Though they haven’t seen each other for years, unlike what Ju-won had imagined, she feels indifferent about their return and is not happy to see them. Meanwhile, the family finds out a shocking truth about Hae-joon at Ju-won’s birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: San-ha’s Confession
Episodes.Description: San-ha’s sudden confession startles Ju-won. While she tries to deny any romance between them and stay as siblings, she is overcome with mixed feelings. Hae-joon jokingly suggests getting married to Ju-won, upsetting San-ha. Meanwhile, a surprise visit from Seo-hyun shocks Jeong-jae as an unexpected turn of events takes place.

Episodes.Title: A New Start
Episodes.Description: San-ha and Ju-won finally confirm their feelings for one another. However, they soon become worried about how to break the news to their family and friends. Meanwhile, Hae-joon tries to pay back Jeong-jae for everything he has done for him, but some misunderstandings develop as Hae-joon’s source of money is revealed.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Having Insomnia
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon finds out that San-ha is struggling with insomnia and taking medication. So-hui comes to visit San-ha alone without telling Jeong-hee and asks him to stay with her and Jeong-hee. Dal keeps trying to hide her feelings for Hae-joon. Meanwhile, a big secret between Ju-won and San-ha is about to be revealed by none other than Hae-joon.

Episodes.Title: Unchosen, Unloved, Alone
Episodes.Description: Hae-joon is filled with a deep sense of betrayal as he watches San-ha and Ju-won on the verge of kissing, struggling to understand how Ju-won could accept San-ha as a boyfriend. He’s haunted by the fear that, like everyone else before them, they too will eventually leave him. Meanwhile, though he knows where his mother is, Hae-joon watches her from a distance, and each glimpse only fuels his growing hatred for her.

Episodes.Title: San-ha Getting Hurt
Episodes.Description: Everyone is happy with San-ha and Ju-won dating, except one person. San Ha gets hurt and rushed to the emergency room and even Jeong-jae and Dae-uk hurriedly come to check on him. Hae-joon decides to play basketball again. Dal is deeply disappointed and devastated. Meanwhile, when Ju-won is alone at her bakery, an unwelcome visitor comes to see her.

Episodes.Title: Someone for Everyone
Episodes.Description: San-ha can't wait any longer. He approaches Jeong-jae and requests his approval to be with Ju-won. Ju-won and Hae-joon try to work some romantic magic between Jeong-jae and Seo-hyun while Dal goes on a blind date, as suggested by Jae-eun. However, Hae-joon doesn't like the idea and doesn't let his chance go. Meanwhile, Jeong-hee plans to move to the UK with So-hee.

Title: Blind
Description: A homicide squad detective, suspected of serial murder, searches for the real culprit.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Dog
Episodes.Description: A young university student Baek Ji-eun gets kidnapped and killed. The investigating detective is Sung-jun and the judge of this case also happens to be his brother, Sung-hoon. Although Sung-jun finds a suspect, the court is not sure whether he is the real culprit or not. As the trial proceeds with a jury, the case draws a lot of attention.

Episodes.Title: You Should Give Up Hope as Long as You're in Here
Episodes.Description: The jury reaches a verdict that Man-chun is guilty and is sentenced to a lifetime in prison. Just when everyone believes that it is now over, Man-chun manages to escape from his convoy and searches for the jurors to seek revenge. However, his vengeance fails and the truth behind the Joker Murder reveals itself.

Episodes.Title: The Children Who He Abandoned
Episodes.Description: Sung-jun wakes up after getting hurt from the hostage situation. But the only things that greet him are his parents’ nagging and the news of another woman’s death. While the public believes the second murder is done by a copycat killer, Sung-hoon gets a hunch that Man-chun is innocent and that there truly is someone else behind the Joker cases.

Episodes.Title: A Very Old Future
Episodes.Description: The jurors are being targeted as the Joker murderer’s victims. As Ki-nam and Moon-kang learn that the cases are related to Hope Welfare, they collect evidence to find their daughters’ killer. Eventually, their investigation leads to the idea that Ryu Sung-jun might be Jung Yoon-jae. Believing this as a fact, Moon-kang kidnaps Sung-jun.

Episodes.Title: A Certain Promise
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun manages to escape from Moon Kang thanks to Eun Ki. As she believes that Sung Jun is not the killer of the Joker Murders, she helps him clear his name. However, the public and the police are certain that he is the culprit. Being chased by his own colleagues, he must prove that he did not kill anyone.

Episodes.Title: The Enemy Is Near
Episodes.Description: Sung Hoon believes that Sung Jun is not the culprit. Not because they are brothers, but because the current evidence is not enough, and that new evidence starts emerging. Kwon Yu Na gets attacked by Choi Soon Gil. As he is one of the suspects in Yeom Hye Jin’s murder, Sung Jun begins digging into him deeper.

Episodes.Title: The Children Who Are Called by Numbers
Episodes.Description: The jurors gather at Kang Young Ki's daughter's wedding while new clues put them into disarray. With everyone gathered, another incident ensues and makes everyone anxious. Was everything planned in detail to get the jurors together from the start?

Episodes.Title: Murder Notice
Episodes.Description: The murder at the wedding has everyone scrambling. An Tae Ho gets spotted on surveillance footage, and the police put an APB on him. Meanwhile, Sung Jun chases after An Tae Ho but loses him. Later, a strange text message gets sent to everyone, making the situation dire.

Episodes.Title: Square One
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun and Sung Hoon are too late, and the "Save Me" event ends in tragedy. However, it's still not over. They get confronted by Moon Kang and his men and almost lose their lives. Luckily, the police arrive just in time, but Sung Jun get taken into custody.

Episodes.Title: The Child Who Survived
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun finds out Eun Ki's mother had worked as a nurse at Hope Welfare Center. To further investigate, Sung Jun goes to meet her. When he finds her, Eun Ki's mother shakes nervously. That night, Sung Jun senses that Eun Ki could be in danger and races to the children's center to see her. Will something happen to Eun Ki?

Episodes.Title: The Ultimate Suspicion
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun tracks down Sung Hoon to save Eun Ki, but his suspicions are wrong. However, Sung Hoon's story doesn't add up, and Sung Jun still feels like Sung Hoon is hiding something. While tailing his brother, the man in black suddenly appears before him.

Episodes.Title: Another Person’s Life
Episodes.Description: Sung Hoon recovers in the hospital after getting stabbed by the culprit. Sung Jun confronts Chief Yeom about Hope Welfare Center and gets told to find out from his mother, Minister Na Guk Hee. Meanwhile, Eun Ki sees Yu Na's dying message and hopes it isn't the person she thinks it is. Later Sung Jun finds evidence that it's the same person at a different location.

Episodes.Title: The People Who Disappeared
Episodes.Description: Eight people, including Eun Ki, suddenly disappear. Could the culprit they've been after all this time be responsible for gathering the eight people in one location? Or could it be a different culprit? Will Sung Jun be able to save the eight people's lives?

Episodes.Title: In Search of Lost Time
Episodes.Description: The eight people held captive and on the brink of death make it out alive. Sung Jun arrests Jung In Seong and takes him into custody. However, he needs more evidence to connect him to the other serial murders. He looks to Sung Hoon for help and manages to get a lead. Meanwhile, Eun Ki proposes exposing the truth about Hope Welfare Center to Sung Hoon.

Episodes.Title: The Designer
Episodes.Description: Sung Jun regains his memory. His suspicions against his brother were true. He questions Jung In Seong for more answers to guess Sung Hoon's next move. Meanwhile, shortly after Sung Jun learns through a court sentencing that the presiding judge of the Hope Welfare Center case twenty years ago was his father, Ryu Il Ho, he rushes to find him.

Episodes.Title: The Final Judgement
Episodes.Description: It turns out Sung Hoon and Sung Jun’s parents are taking a big part in the secret behind Hope Welfare Center. Despite the sorrow, Sung Jun must arrest both of his own parents. After their arrest, Sung Hoon also gets arrested for the murders. Regardless of the judgment that he will get, he is relieved to fulfill his lifelong revenge.

Title: Avatar the Last Airbender
Description: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.

Episodes.Title: Aang
Episodes.Description: An Airbender comes to grips with his new reality as war erupts. A century later, a pair of Water Tribe siblings make a discovery that changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Warriors
Episodes.Description: Aang, Katara and Sokka arrive at a small Island, home to elite warriors named after Avatar Kyoshi. The Fire Nation gets wind of the Avatar's whereabouts.

Episodes.Title: Omashu
Episodes.Description: News of a traitor puts the trio at odds in Omashu, where a mechanist and rebels with a charming leader muddle their plans to protect the Earth Kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Into the Dark
Episodes.Description: In captivity, Aang meets a king with a taste for games. To find their friend, the siblings must navigate a dark tunnel — and put their differences aside.

Episodes.Title: Spirited Away
Episodes.Description: When the group lands in the Spirit World for a rescue mission, they come face to face with dangerous threats, painful memories and a mysterious entity.

Episodes.Title: Masks
Episodes.Description: A desperate Aang visits Avatar Roku for help on his journey as the Fire Nation closes in on him. At their fortress, a masked intruder breaks Aang out.

Episodes.Title: The North
Episodes.Description: As an attack on the Northern Water Tribe looms, Katara challenges a master Waterbender, Sokka meets a princess, and Aang takes Kuruk's words to heart.

Episodes.Title: Legends
Episodes.Description: Zhao leads the Fire Nation into the North with a bold plan to weaken the Water Tribe. When the battle takes a dark turn, Aang enters a powerful state.

Title: All of Us Are Dead
Description: A high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped students must fight their way out — or turn into one of the rabid infected.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Inside Lee Byeong-chan's science lab, a student incurs a seemingly harmless bite. Shortly after, a fast-spreading outbreak soaks the school in blood.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The infected multiply in droves. Scrambling for their lives, Nam On-jo and Lee Cheong-san find safety with others inside a classroom — but not for long.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: When one of the group is scratched while fighting a zombie, Lee Na-yeon demands they kick him out. Outside, the virus swallows up the city.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In need of a cellphone, two students take a risky journey to the teachers' office. Byeong-chan passes on critical information to Detective Song Jae-ik.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Martial law is imposed on the city. When Cheong-san is separated from the rest of the group, On-jo leads a mission to use a drone to locate him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The group clears a path to Cheong-san using sound to draw away zombies, but a new type of threat surfaces. Nam So-ju breaks out of the quarantine camp.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: To make it out of the music room and onto the roof, the students put into action their most perilous plan yet. Elsewhere, Jae-ik comes across a setback.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jae-ik and his crew run into a student from the school. Na-yeon works up the courage to face her peers. The group shares confessions around a fire.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A disturbance at the camp shifts the military's understanding of the virus. A thunderstorm provides cover as the group agrees to keep on moving.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The auditorium quickly becomes a trap for the two newly united teams of survivors. Byeong-chan's video logs reveal a drastic solution to the crisis.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Though a surprise protector provides the group safe passage to their next stop, Yoon Gwi-nam is not far behind. The military makes a grave decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: The students make it to the quarantine camp, each of them weighed down by tragic loss. Months later, they hang on to hope for a survivor.

Title: Descendants of the Sun
Description: After a chance meeting in a hospital, an ardent soldier falls for a gifted surgeon. Opposing philosophies tear them apart, but fate has other plans.

Episodes.Title: Will You Be My Doctor?
Episodes.Description: While on vacation after a sensitive military operation, soldier Si-jin senses a connection with Mo-yeon, a beautiful and strong-willed surgeon.

Episodes.Title: We Bump Into Each Other While Passing By
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Dae-young engage in a perilous operation in Afghanistan, while Mo-yeon assists in surgery. Later, Si-jin and Mo-yeon take in a movie.

Episodes.Title: How Have You Been?
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Alpha Team join Mo-yeon and the doctors in Urk. Meanwhile, Myung-ju doesn't like how her father, Lt. Gen. Yoon, treats Dae-young.

Episodes.Title: I Will Find a Way to Drink
Episodes.Description: Tempers flare over a dying man when Mo-yeon insists she can save the patient's life. Meanwhile, Dae-young and Myung-ju reunite at the airport.

Episodes.Title: What Should I Do About the Kiss
Episodes.Description: After sharing a moment, Mo-yeon isn't sure what to think about her relationship with Si-jin. Later, Si-jin receives a panicked phone call.

Episodes.Title: I Shouldn't Have Received His Apology
Episodes.Description: After a powerful earthquake strikes Urk, the country descends into chaos. It's up to the medical team and soldiers to search for survivors.

Episodes.Title: I Missed You
Episodes.Description: In the earthquake's aftermath, heartbreaking decisions must be made by Si-jin and Mo-yeon, who both strive to save as many people as possible.

Episodes.Title: Comfort the Deceased With a Silent Prayer
Episodes.Description: When an aftershock strikes, Mo-yeon sees firsthand just how dangerous Si-jin's job can be. Later, an old phone message is accidentally broadcast.

Episodes.Title: That Wasn't Me
Episodes.Description: Mo-yeon is embarrassed after her unintentional confession, but Si-jin isn't about to let her off the hook. Meanwhile, a visitor makes everyone nervous.

Episodes.Title: You Got a Parcel From Shin Ji Young
Episodes.Description: Dae-young is rattled after seeing an old nemesis, Mo-yeon shares a dark dinner with Si-jin, and an unusual package arrives from home.

Episodes.Title: Who on Earth Stole It?
Episodes.Description: While Dae-young and Myung-ju remain quarantined, the rest of the team fights the epidemic. Meanwhile, the supply truck with the cure disappears.

Episodes.Title: As of This Moment, Everyone Will Return to Team Alpha
Episodes.Description: Dae-young has a bad feeling about Si-jin's solo mission into Argus's hideout. Mo-yeon wonders if she's capable of dealing with Si-jin's secrecy.

Episodes.Title: You're Not My Director Any More
Episodes.Description: The medical team returns to their regular lives, but something's off. Meanwhile, Mo-yeon makes a bold career move, and Dae-young faces a tough choice.

Episodes.Title: The Movie We Missed
Episodes.Description: After a patient is rushed to the hospital, Mo-yeon is shocked to see who is in need of care. Meanwhile, a microchip reveals unexpected information.

Episodes.Title: I Will Stay Alive
Episodes.Description: Si-jin and Mo-yeon spend some much deserved time together. Dae-young and Myung-ju continue to have communication problems. Devastating news arrives.

Episodes.Title: A Promise Made in the Dark
Episodes.Description: As the team faces a new threat, Si-jin and Mo-yeon's relationship is tested like never before. Meanwhile, secrets from the past come to light.

Episodes.Title: The Hardest Goodbye
Episodes.Description: A mission goes wrong, forcing everyone to make impossible choices. Dae-young and Myung-ju finally confront their feelings for each other.

Episodes.Title: When the Sun Sets
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of tragedy, the team must find a way to move forward. Si-jin makes a decision that will change everything.

Episodes.Title: The Soldier's Vow
Episodes.Description: As danger closes in, Si-jin and Mo-yeon fight to protect everything they love. A familiar face returns with shocking news.

Episodes.Title: This Is Unbelievable
Episodes.Description: Mo-yeon and Myung-ju learn that not everything is what it seems. Meanwhile, a promotion is cause for celebration, and a trip reignites old passions.

Title: Twinkling Watermelon
Description: A CODA (child of deaf adult) student born with a gift for music crash lands at an unfamiliar place after time traveling through a suspicious music shop. There, he forms the band Watermelon Sugar with other mysterious youths.

Episodes.Title: Passion Is Born
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol and his family move into a new neighborhood. He meets a man who offers to teach him how to play the guitar, and Eun-gyeol works hard to learn it. As he deals with bullies at school, he practices playing the guitar until he is as good as the man who taught him. However, tragedy strikes, and he and his family are forced to move again.

Episodes.Title: Eun-gyeol Quits Music
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol tries his best to quit music, but it's not easy for him to do. He gets scouted to join SPINE9, an indie band in Hongdae. To make things worse, he finally gets his hands on the guitar promised by the Viva Music store owner. He is torn by which path to take and finds himself walking into a suspicious music store.

Episodes.Title: Seoul 1995
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol gets stuck in 1995 and doesn't know how to return to the present. What's worse is that he meets his young father, Yi-chan, who can talk and wants to start a band to impress a girl who isn't Eun-gyeol's mother. Eun-gyeol poses as Yoon Dong-jin, a musical genius, in order to try to become a member of Yi-chan's band.

Episodes.Title: Eun-gyeol Becomes Yi-chan's Tutor
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol encounters Se-gyeong in her teens and learns a few things about her life that don't make sense in the future. Meanwhile, Yi-chan meets Chung-ah for the first time, but she doesn't say a word. Yi-chan tries to get away from Eun-gyeol, but Eun-gyeol follows him to the Snail Guesthouse and ends up becoming Yi-chan's math tutor.

Episodes.Title: Se-gyeong Leaves the Country
Episodes.Description: Eun-gyeol resolves to stop the accident that caused Yi-chan to become deaf and clings to him, vowing to teach him everything he needs to know. He even promises to gift him the band Yi-chan needs. However, the school festival is in one month, and the person Yi-chan is doing this for has left the country and isn't going to return.

Episodes.Title: Se-gyeong Returns
Episodes.Description: Everyone is confused at Se-gyeong's return, especially Eun-gyeol, who sternly warns her to stay away from Yi-chan. However, it doesn't work, and Se-gyeong approaches Yi-chan with different intentions. Meanwhile, Chung-ah can only stand by and watch as she realizes she's lost her chance to tell Yi-chan how she feels.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You Eun-gyeol?
